economy.zh:
今晨全球金融市场聚焦于SK海力士（SK Hynix）在纳斯达克的巨额上市，融资265亿美元创外国公司历史之最，这一事件同时牵动韩国“打折”问题与亚太内存芯片产业链重估。与此同时，美伊局势在特朗普声称“停火结束”后仍维持技术谈判，但原油市场已将此视为“可控”，布伦特与WTI双双回落2.2%。美联储主席Kevin Warsh公布五大货币政策工作组名单，邀请Marc Andreessen等外部专家，预示政策评估路径或将转向。欧洲方面，拉加德再次呼吁构建能与美债抗衡的“欧洲安全资产”，而西班牙提出的新债务方案正在引发内部辩论。中国A股今日医药板块爆发，创新药与医疗服务领涨，沪指半日涨0.76%；香港市场则出现分化：优衣库逆势增长，但智谱AI港股跌超10%，且小型IPO集体破发。同花顺社区热度集中在种业/玉米板块及疫苗ETF，显示资金正围绕粮食安全与医药主题博弈。

- **[SK Hynix raises $26.5bn in mega US share sale](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gym70r0y4o)** — 韩国存储龙头的纳斯达克首秀不仅是芯片行业里程碑，也直接测试“韩国折价”能否被全球资本定价抹平。参照同日长鑫存储启动43亿美元上海IPO，全球内存融资竞赛白热化。
- **[U.S. to continue 'technical talks' with Iran after Trump said ceasefire was 'over'](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/us-iran-war-strikes-strait-of-hormuz-technical-talks-progress-.html)** — 尽管口头升级，双方依然保留沟通渠道；油价回落说明市场暂时押注冲突不会进一步扩大，但霍尔木兹海峡风险未消，需关注下周谈判结果。
- **[Kevin Warsh names members of his Federal Reserve task forces](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/kevin-warsh-names-members-of-his-federal-reserve-task-forces-including-marc-andreessen-doug-mcmillon.html)** — 任命a16z创始人、沃尔玛CEO等非传统人选，可能预示美联储将重新审视货币政策传导机制与科技对通胀的影响，市场对此反应中性偏积极。
- **[ECB’s Lagarde calls for a European safe asset to rival US Treasuries](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5uZGFHT2tXV3Y0SEhGdHVDS1FIOHRnc3Bjd0RGQlJ6Y2tZemk4QXBBaWNVVXdyVVpRVG5tbUdGb2R5QzhjRmhIYk9JbUdoYVlfQ0dqLU9OUFVZLUx4TDJyT205Nkd5RGttX1ZZdk9naUduYmMxbUVJSWs1emdoZw)** — 结合欧洲天然气库存不足100天、大众裁员10万等消息，欧洲正面临能源与产业转型双重压力，安全资产的缺失进一步制约财政空间。
- **[A股午评：沪指半日涨0.76%，创新药、医疗服务板块集体爆发](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5PQ2xuOGVPdlh3QXhWS05xY1VwSlBMNTVSR1d1WkQwRjVPV0hUY0RkYWZ3bkw5NlNLMUNMdFBHLUtVQ3lVVWZlNFhrTU80X2FnWmFMdTV5SUpPLXZyMkE)** — 医药板块的强劲表现可能与近期政策利好及中报预期有关；同花顺社区内“又一只首日10倍股出现”也反映投机情绪升温。
- **[Hong Kong exchange marks progress in luring more listings from abroad](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3360049/hong-kong-exchange-marks-progress-luring-more-listings-abroad)** — 港交所吸引哈萨克斯坦铁路等海外公司，但小盘IPO首日破发率达38%，显示流动性分化加剧，资金向AI等大交易集中。

**后续观察：** 下周需重点关注：SK海力士纳市首日定价及后续估值变化，这将影响其他亚洲芯片企业的上市策略；美伊技术谈判若破裂，能源价格将重新飙升；中国医药板块是否具备持续性，以及港交所能否通过人民币业务设施缓解流动性分层。
economy.en:
The global economic landscape is volatile, with major market moves driven by the SK Hynix mega-IPO, shifting US-Iran tensions, and an ECB push for a European safe asset. In China, A-share markets showed resilience with healthcare and corn sectors surging, while Hong Kong faces IPO dynamics. The following key developments demand attention:

- **SK Hynix's $26.5bn Nasdaq debut** is the largest foreign listing ever, testing the 'Korea discount' thesis. The chipmaker's shares start trading Friday, offering direct exposure to the AI memory cycle. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/sk-hynix-debuts-on-nasdaq-will-that-bridge-its-korea-discount-.html) [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gym70r0y4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **US-Iran ceasefire frays** as technical talks continue despite Trump declaring the ceasefire 'over.' Oil markets reacted with a 2.2% drop as traders view tensions as 'contained.' [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/us-iran-war-strikes-strait-of-hormuz-technical-talks-progress-.html) [Bloomberg](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOX29jNzlrVEkybnhoWGJTdG9JZWNCbG05cm45aFBhMG1YTVVSTkFDZWRtWlFMdXN0RTNhOHduTnlHVFN4YVFjdmdSbU9JdHY3TUpYQ2U2ZXlOXzY3aUxkbzhmQWs4M3NHbHYyVjRKNExjRzdnWmpLTzBuQzV3YUJKVTM5VHVUQTROZVZZNldNWWk2UGFSWWJWRjJDeWZURG85aWJFMWY2WVl2NHRyTmFkSXZKVW4)
- **Fed Chair Warsh names task forces** including Marc Andreessen and Doug McMillon to review monetary policy operations, signaling potential structural changes. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/kevin-warsh-names-members-of-his-federal-reserve-task-forces-including-marc-andreessen-doug-mcmillan.html) [Fed](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260709a.htm)
- **ECB's Lagarde calls for a European safe asset** to rival US Treasuries, as Spain pitches fresh debt plans. The ECB also grapples with energy shock implications. [Crypto Briefing](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5uZGFHT2tXV3Y0SEhGdHVDS1FIOHRnc3Bjd0RGQlJ6Y2tZemk4QXBBaWNVVXdyVVpRVG5tbUdGb2R5QzhjRmhIYk9JbUdoYVlfQ0dqLU9OUFVZLUx4TDJyT205Nkd5RGttX1ZZdk9naUduYmMxbUVJSWs1emdoZw) [WSJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOVDdVYktZc2c5Mkxyd05OR1VDOE5XTVpVZzRka0tBTG9iOEx1X3B0OC16R0Z4TndzWGlLbm43NkRyZFVqWHFjYlFMeWJ1S3pWUlEzYlYyZ3g0dGFDOERsQWRQa0xqZm92amY4N2ItZEJ2WUtITlYzTkJfN1BjdTlhcU1HaFhYZ0ZQbDZLOHAtcFd6WFliSDR3Y0pXbEE2aWhRbFNQY2V2OExKanVf)
- **Europe faces natural gas inventory crisis** with fewer than 100 days to resolve, amid fresh volatility from Iran. VW confronts massive job cuts and protests. [Seeking Alpha](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPRDJabmN6NHZCRzVMU2plMjhCTVBLb19WTkJZSDBfd3prUFlWRy1aZlpualhDQzlpQTBWNWlhQnBhWVgtWlF3NGlERmZMNUpRb3MxZ05zaG5XakRNTE5PYW1qMTNGby1IYWc5MWltZUtzMW5PTEwtWmlGZWpDYk1ITWhvX3V2VjluNnFWTWVmb1JqR2dBaEVzOE1LbVJsVEdSVERTS0tmM1EyUzZ1U2tJaTBURlhyS3lqak9WcHRWWF84dHhMNTVoZ3ln) [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/09/vw-protests-germany-proposed-job-cuts-factory-closures)
- **China's ChangXin Memory (CXMT) sets $4.3bn Shanghai IPO** amid semiconductor boom, while SK Hynix's US debut and Korea's Kospi entering bear territory highlight shifting chip dynamics. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3359955/chinas-top-dram-maker-sets-date-us43b-shanghai-ipo-amid-memory-boom) [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/kospi-bear-territory-ai-samsung-skhynix-chipmakers.html)
- **Hong Kong IPO market sees divergence**: small-caps struggle as AI-focused Zhipu AI drops 10%, but the bourse draws foreign listings from Kazakhstan. Michael Burry sees Hong Kong benefiting from Korea's AI-memory unwind. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3359991/small-cap-ipos-struggle-hong-kong-amid-lack-ai-megadeals) [Yahoo Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNQm1vLWtZLTJZTVl0MUNDa3N4VTZNN25rVWVRd25PZlpKR1NDUXRjdHNkTEF0OElrMnlPQ1RHVzdiRG90UHlVUWdJR1FwejBfeDByTHVZcDhINTY5WW9YLUtsaXNfYzNDLVBtNHlfS1pFRVdScjdodzFkZmh3RWhMQ1dNM2JPdmdIbFZKSWIySjV0VFpqdXpJMg)
- **A-share market rallies**: Shanghai Composite up 0.76% at midday, with healthcare (vaccine ETF +6%) and corn stocks surging. A new 10x debut stock appears. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5PQ2xuOGVPdlh3QXhWS05xY1VwSlBMNTVSR1d1WkQwRjVPV0hUY0RkYWZ3bkw5NlNLMUNMdFBHLUtVQ3lVVWZlNFhrTU80X2FnWmFMdTV5SUpPLXZyMkE) [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE91bWRZUXh0OTIxRFZnMHU4bUlVeG1DNlU1OVVNNEpaRWstSm1pVWVKYTJIYWlwTFNNeWhOanE0Mno2YzBSa1haeEVDdXVJTzF5YXl1aGJvQTZ0SmtMLWhIOA)

**Watch next:** Oil and defense stocks could spike if US-Iran talks break down. SK Hynix's Nasdaq trading pattern will signal investor appetite for Korean chips. China's CXMT IPO pricing may set the tone for memory sector valuations. Europe's gas storage data next week will be critical for winter pricing. Fed task force recommendations due in months could reshape monetary policy tools.

society.zh:
今日国际社会被多条冲突线撕裂：美伊在哈梅内伊下葬日互袭，北约峰会刚结束即面临战火重燃；乌克兰持续打击克里米亚俄舰，同时被控谋杀摩纳哥炸弹案嫌疑人；加沙人道主义悲剧再添一笔——曾组织世界杯观赛的援助工作者遭以色列空袭身亡。欧洲南部的热浪则引发西班牙致命野火，希腊战机在旅游机场惊险迫降。国内方面，国务院印发《“十五五”碳达峰行动方案》，新一轮能源转型路线图落地；高层密集强调科技自立自强，手机木马病毒警示数字安全。知乎社区围绕营收下滑、AI面试争议、院士科普雷达技术等话题形成讨论热点。

- 美伊冲突骤然升级：美国中央司令部称打击了90个伊朗目标，伊朗卫生部确认14人死亡；伊朗还指控美军袭击了布什尔省军事总部，但美方否认。与此同时，美国授权乌克兰本土生产“爱国者”导弹，成为北约峰会重要成果——[美伊互袭](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz75zjj5wp8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)与[乌克兰获准自制爱国者](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/10/zelenskyy-urges-urgent-efforts-in-ukraine-to-start-patriot-production?traffic_source=rss)两条线索同时升温。
- 加沙世界杯组织者之死：援助工作者穆罕默德·瓦希迪在埃及对阿根廷比赛前夜遭以军空袭身亡，他曾为加沙难民搭建露天屏观看世界杯——[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwylznzjk04o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)与[半岛电视台](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/7/10/gaza-mourns-aid-worker-killed-by-israel-who-helped-them-see-the-world-cup?traffic_source=rss)均以头条报道，凸显冲突中人道主义空间的萎缩。
- 西班牙阿尔梅里亚省野火致12人死亡，6人受伤，南欧热浪持续——[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c8e2382jk7jo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)报道，对比希腊F-16战斗机在扎金索斯机场迫焚烧毁，旅游业安全引发担忧。
- 乌克兰特工案出现翻供：两名与乌安全局有联系的男子被控谋杀摩纳哥炸弹案嫌疑人阿纳斯塔西娅·别列佐夫斯卡娅，其中一人改变证词——[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cpv3e8y39j7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)揭示案件复杂化，可能波及国际司法。
- 中国“十五五”碳达峰方案出台，国家发改委详解目标路径，同时零售业创新政策落地，力图提振消费信心——[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE1pWVNFS2RxRDFLYnZWMUMzYkJhSVhSR3JxTWJIOVVaZGR0ZzVyUVNCQW5DZFhVelFhN2YyUGlaWVMtbF9jWk1McDhZYWlzNmFkWm9fV2I5Qy1QbFJfS3ZYQi03TEdhanB5WkwycGFMTGVMaHFKakNSaGppQ1pVZFk)与[新华社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBESVBxNFBSQndXUWNGTEFoLUY3Sl82Mi1iTlVhNWY3eC1uQ2Y5WXBReXhfT0xwanVSUnQ0LXh0SkdQbFJ4V3RyV0dsSWdBODYxTlFtNVZQcVRVZWsyWEFBbUM0dU9ZdksxbHp2M3UxeFp3NU5ldWVqaEZ2SC1xZw)。
- 知乎财报显示营收同比下滑23.6%，CEO周源明确加速AI商业化，此前公司已启动回购——[财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NrQ2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)与[富途](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPRnVoLVdzOUczNUl6OVFNVHkzVGMtbmZlR18tNjB2TWdCMmF3ZElxcXFjZG4xa3Q3LUFkelF3QWN1dHU4QUd1VklrVXVmNWlLcDUxVGhFaUR3MTNhOGZWeUwwRHJUaEJDMm5VMlJudVpsUVF5LXBuR1poS0lwZ2xrQ2Q5U2VXcmQ4cFFBeGdsc3NaZGNRM1JuRA)信息印证。

**后续观察**：美伊之间“打一下停一下”的节奏可能因哈梅内伊葬礼的象征意义而复杂化，伊朗对海湾阿拉伯国家的报复威胁正在改变地区航运格局（霍尔木兹海峡船舶流量已下降）；乌克兰战场外溢效应在特工谋杀案中显现，欧洲司法与情报边界面临考验。中国碳达峰方案的实施细节和配套资金将是下一步焦点。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by escalating geopolitical tensions and natural disasters. The US and Iran engaged in a new round of strikes, while Ukraine continued targeting Russian assets near Crimea. A tragic wildfire in Spain claimed a dozen lives, and a beloved Gaza aid worker was killed by an Israeli strike. In East Asia, North Korea condemned growing Seoul-Tokyo military ties, and Japan braced for Typhoon Bavi. China released its '15th Five-Year Plan' for carbon peak and highlighted progress in tech self-reliance. The following key developments deserve attention:

- **US-Iran conflict escalates**: The US launched new airstrikes against Iran, hitting 90 targets, while Iran retaliated against US-allied Gulf states. Iran's health ministry reported 14 killed since Tuesday. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz75zjj5wp8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/09/g-s1-132670/us-iran-strikes))
- **Ukraine strikes Russian ships near Crimea**: Ukraine intensified attacks on Russian fuel supplies and shipping routes, aiming to choke off supplies to occupied Crimea. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c70yd1g67z5o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Gaza mourns aid worker who organized World Cup screenings**: Mohammed al-Wahidi, a prominent humanitarian, was killed in an Israeli strike on the eve of a World Cup match. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwylznzjk04o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/7/10/gaza-mourns-aid-worker-killed-by-israel-who-helped-them-see-the-world-cup?traffic_source=rss))
- **Spain wildfire kills 12**: A blaze in Los Gallardos, Almería, left six injured as Southern Europe continues to suffer a heatwave. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c8e2382jk7jo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **North Korea warns of 'self-destruction' over Seoul-Tokyo military cooperation**: Pyongyang condemned the growing defense ties between South Korea and Japan. ([UPI](https://news.google.))
- **China unveils '15th Five-Year Plan' for carbon peak**: The State Council released a new action plan aiming to cap carbon emissions, with detailed measures for industry and energy. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBESVBxNFBSQndXUWNGTEFoLUY3Sl82Mi1iTlVhNWY3eC1uQ2Y5WXBReXhfT0xwanVSUnQ0LXh0SkdQbFJ4V3RyV0dsSWdBODYxTlFtNVZQcVRVZWsyWEFBbUM0dU9ZdksxbHp2M3UxeFp3NU5ldWVqaEZ2SC1xZw))
- **Typhoon Bavi approaches remote Japanese islands**: Flights and ferries have been canceled as the storm barrels toward isolated communities. ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxNZGtZWC01aWVXVUYxLUNqR2JhdzhzNnQyMWVWdGlQS2tPUG83Vi1mMUNrLVRjMGVLZFFycVlWMEVoWG4tMkN5LTctZUx4TGN2dGUwSUJtZF9SbVgySlhkb04wdGpzRXFEdm56a0oySktmOGRaVW9mcXFib3JxTm5ndnNuaFRkRUZ5RmdlQVB4QmxVazda))

**Watch next:** The US-Iran tit-for-tat may spiral further, with implications for global oil shipping through Hormuz. Ukraine’s Patriot missile production license could reshape air defense dynamics. The NATO summit aftermath will test alliances. In Asia, Typhoon Bavi could bring significant disruption to Japan’s infrastructure. China’s carbon peak plan and retail innovation policies will influence domestic markets and global climate talks.

military.zh:
过去24小时，全球军事态势呈现多重升级与结构性调整。美伊冲突进入第三天，双方互袭目标扩大至三国基地，伊朗声称打击了美国在四个国家的目标，而美方称已摧毁170个伊朗目标，和平谈判前景渺茫。与此同时，中国在太平洋试射潜射弹道导弹（SLBM）引发关注，分析认为这标志着中国向持续海上核威慑转型。德国宣布采购陆基“战斧”巡航导弹，北约对俄常规打击姿态发生重大转变。五角大楼寻求转移43亿美元以应对未预见的人员与行动成本，同时启动6.27亿美元激光武器项目。以下为各子专栏详细解读。

- **[美伊冲突进入第三天：双方互袭范围扩大](https://www.twz.com/news-features/renewed-attacks-between-u-s-and-iran-stretch-into-third-day)**——特朗普称停火“结束”后，伊朗在24小时内打击了美国在四个国家的基地，美方则回应已打击170个伊朗目标，冲突烈度与地理范围均显著上升。
- **[中国太平洋SLBM测试标志核威慑转型](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/china-pacific-slbm-test-casd-nuclear-deterrence/)**——中国海军核潜艇7月6日向太平洋发射模拟弹头的潜射弹道导弹，分析认为此举表明北京正在向“持续海上威慑”能力迈进。
- **[德国采购陆基“战斧”导弹：北约打击姿态转变](https://www.twz.com/land/germany-to-buy-ground-launched-tomahawk-missiles)**——德国计划购买陆基战斧，这是北约应对俄罗斯威胁的重大常规打击能力调整，将大幅改变欧洲力量对比。
- **[五角大楼申请转移430亿美元应对运营与人员成本](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/pentagon-seeks-to-shift-4-3b-to-pay-for-increasing-operation-and-personnel-costs/)**——在一份47页的综合调整通知中，五角大楼拟从多个武器和技术项目中抽资，以支付“未预见的军事需求”。
- **[美国“林肯”号航母连续部署超200天](https://www.twz.com/sea/supercarrier-uss-abraham-lincoln-passes-200-consecutive-days-at-sea-mark)**——自2025年12月以来未进港，该舰在中东海域的持续部署凸显美军在高强度对抗下的后勤极限。
- **[乌克兰防空系统6月拦截率近90%](https://news.google.)**——乌克兰称尽管面临弹道导弹威胁，6月大规模袭击中防空系统仍保持近90%拦截率。
- **后续观察**：美伊冲突走向将是短期最大不确定性因素，伊朗打击美国多国基地的行为可能触发更广泛的中东战争。中国SLBM测试与德国战斧采购则分别标志着核威慑与常规打击领域的长期结构变化，需关注后续军控与联盟动态。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by the rapid escalation of military exchanges between the United States and Iran, following President Trump's declaration that the ceasefire is 'over.' This has triggered a cascade of retaliatory strikes, significant policy shifts in defense budgeting, and renewed focus on naval power projection and deterrence postures across the Indo-Pacific and Europe. The crisis is reshaping global energy markets, alliance dynamics, and the strategic calculus of major powers.

- **U.S.-Iran Conflict Intensifies:** The U.S. struck 170 Iranian targets in retaliation for ship attacks, while Iran responded by striking U.S. bases in four countries within 24 hours. The future of peace talks remains deeply uncertain ([U.S. says 170 Iran targets hit](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQMXU3aVlzZThDSGVOQmpqSERlLThRdGIxV3RhV00zeEthbUp4ZktxUjhsMHRvMGZ6VjAtYUlRYjRvR184ekxuRmNnUzRFa2lRQ2ZkMWlIczFFOGdaTlA1VE9qbHMyMjdwYTdnZy1PRnp1REl3a2NNaWxBdm5JeklKSnF6YmRXcVFHZ0ZjWGQtSG5RX3JXbHhCZHRjVl9XdFdpR3c2c3VsOFQ), [Iran Strikes US Bases](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxOTmdpZUh0ci1YZzFLeTAwWEFOYXBsaXU0bnhkZHJjOWtFaDZrWmlnZU9nSHhCUmthdzQ2ZnBBcENqQUNKcUR0d0RUdTI4WS1neERqaHQyLU5XTEo1cDl2WVdKOXlXdWlHZGNvcDdJeVNNX21ELURqcTNvX0tnZ0pOZ0xmS1FsQQ)).
- **Pentagon Shifts $4.3B for Unforeseen Requirements:** In a 47-page omnibus reprogramming notification, the Pentagon seeks to pull dollars from various weapon and tech programs to cover rising operation and personnel costs ([Pentagon seeks to shift $4.3B](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/pentagon-seeks-to-shift-4-3b-to-pay-for-increasing-operation-and-personnel-costs/)).
- **China’s J-15T Breaks Cover with Four Anti-Ship Missiles:** The catapult-equipped carrier Fujian has unlocked the J-15T’s strike potential, with the fighter seen carrying four anti-ship missiles for the first time ([Chinese J-15 Fighter Seen Launching](https://www.twz.com/sea/chinese-j-15-fighter-seen-launching-from-a-carrier-with-four-anti-ship-missiles-for-first-time)).
- **China Tests SLBM into Pacific, Signaling Continuous At-Sea Deterrence:** Analysis of the July 6 submarine-launched ballistic missile test into the Pacific indicates a maturing sea-based nuclear deterrent, with implications for regional stability ([China’s Pacific SLBM Test](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/china-pacific-slbm-test-casd-nuclear-deterrence/)).
- **Germany to Buy Ground-Launched Tomahawks:** This major shift in NATO’s conventional strike posture responds to the Russian threat and marks a new phase in European missile-based deterrence ([Germany To Buy Ground-Launched Tomahawk Missiles](https://www.twz.com/land/germany-to-buy-ground-launched-tomahawk-missiles)).
- **USS Abraham Lincoln Surpasses 200 Consecutive Days at Sea:** The carrier, operating in the Middle East, has not made a port call since December 2025, underlining the high operational tempo in the region ([Supercarrier USS Abraham Lincoln](https://www.twz.com/sea/supercarrier-uss-abraham-lincoln-passes-200-consecutive-days-at-sea-mark)).
- **Ukraine Maintains 90% Interception Rate in June Despite Ballistic Missile Threat:** Air defenses proved highly effective during large-scale June attacks, though the ballistic missile threat remains a concern ([Ukraine says air defences maintained nearly 90% interception rate](https://news.google.)).

**Watch next:** The trajectory of U.S.-Iran hostilities will be the key driver of global security in the coming days, with potential for further escalation and spillover into energy markets and shipping lanes. The NATO summit’s outcomes and the evolving naval posture of China in the Indo-Pacific also warrant close monitoring.

tech.zh:
今日科技板块呈现三条主线：一是**全球电动汽车市场分化加剧**，6月销量突破200万辆，但美国因政策倒退和本土企业战略失误正在掉队；二是**AI行业人才与权力洗牌**，OpenAI二号人物Fidji Simo因病离职、GPT-5.6发布，而Anthropic凭借技术透明度和人才引力持续崛起；三是**政策与商业的碰撞**，特斯拉的纯视觉Robotaxi在新泽西遇阻、马斯克与SEC和解虽被法官质疑但获批准、Xbox裁员后CEO却受聘美联储咨询就业。以下是各子专栏的详细解读。

- **全球EV销量破200万，美国加速落后**：6月全球电动汽车销量首次单月突破200万辆，但[Electrek指出](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/global-ev-sales-hit-2-million-in-june-and-the-us-falls-further-behind/)美国市场份额进一步下滑，而中国和欧洲增长强劲。
- **特斯拉Robotaxi遭新泽西法案狙击**：新泽西州拟立法要求自动驾驶商用车辆必须配备摄像头外至少两种传感器（雷达和激光雷达），[直接封堵了特斯拉仅靠摄像头方案](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/new-jersey-bill-tesla-camera-robotaxi/)，除非马斯克改变立场。
- **OpenAI高层震荡与模型迭代**：AGI负责人Fidji Simo因健康问题转为兼职顾问，[正值公司可能IPO与追赶Anthropic](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/fidji-simo-steps-down-from-openais-no-2-role/)的关键期；同日发布的[GPT-5.6](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/openai-launches-its-new-family-of-models-with-gpt-5-6/)被指定为Microsoft Copilot首选模型，暗示双方合作未受“分手传闻”影响。
- **Anthropic步步紧逼**：[前美联储主席伯南克加入Anthropic监督信托](https://www.anthropic.com/news/ben-bernanke)，强化治理；同时[发现Claude内部存在“概念推演”隐藏空间](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/09/1140293/anthropic-found-a-hidden-space-where-claude-puzzles-over-concepts/)，技术透明度提升。
- **AI人才争夺白热化**：[Google两名顶级AI专家跳槽Anthropic](https://news.google.)（MSN报道），而全年已有22位教授被OpenAI等公司从顶尖高校挖走。
- **AI agent创业新范式**：Lyzr公司用自家AI agent完成了1亿美元融资，[证明产品实用性](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/an-ai-agent-startup-just-let-its-agent-run-its-100-million-fundraise/)；OpenAI则关闭了浏览器产品Atlas，将Agent功能移至桌面应用和Chrome扩展。

**后续观察**：美国电动车市场面临政策退坡与本土企业保守的双重打击，而中国车企（如比亚迪、MG）正以差异化产品（PHEV、半固态电池）攻入欧洲。AI领域，OpenAI与Anthropic的攻防战进入深水区——前者失去关键高管，后者引入政治与学术力量，GPT-5.6能否守住微软生态的阵地有待检验。HackNews社区对工作与生活平衡的反思（如《Focus》文章）值得科技从业者关注。
tech.en:
A turbulent 24 hours in technology: OpenAI simultaneously launched GPT-5.6 and lost its No. 2 executive, the global EV market crossed 2 million monthly sales while the U.S. fell further behind, and a New Jersey bill threatened Tesla’s camera-only Robotaxi. China demonstrated a novel molten-salt solar plant, Trump’s clean-energy rollbacks erased $68 billion in investment, and Anthropic revealed a hidden reasoning space inside Claude. The AI talent war intensified as top professors were poached, and Microsoft’s carbon emissions surged 25%.

- [OpenAI launches GPT-5.6](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/openai-launches-its-new-family-of-models-with-gpt-5-6/) as [Fidji Simo steps down](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/fidji-simo-steps-down-from-openais-no-2-role/) from her AGI chief role — a leadership vacuum at a critical time as the company eyes an IPO and competition with Anthropic in the enterprise.
- [Global EV sales hit 2 million in June](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/global-ev-sales-hit-2-million-in-june-and-the-us-falls-further-behind/) — the U.S. share shrinks as China and Europe accelerate, and Hyundai launches aggressive [0% APR deals](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/hyundai-launches-ev-deals-0-apr-up-to-10000-off/) to compete.
- [China’s 1 GW Hami solar plant](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/china-hami-solar-molten-salt-storage/) uses molten salt to deliver power for 8 hours after dark — no lithium batteries required.
- [Trump clean-energy rollbacks](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/trump-clean-energy-rollbacks-erase-68b-in-us-investment/) have cost the U.S. $68 billion in private investment and 470,000 jobs, per a new report.
- [New Jersey bill S1677](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/new-jersey-bill-tesla-camera-robotaxi/) would require lidar and radar for driverless commercial vehicles — effectively banning Tesla’s camera-only Robotaxi while allowing Waymo.
- [Anthropic’s Jacobian lens](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/09/1140293/anthropic-found-a-hidden-space-where-claude-puzzles-over-concepts/) reveals a “hidden space” where Claude puzzles over concepts, giving the clearest view yet inside an LLM.
- [AI talent war escalates](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE1XSFJ6S0NwYkpKWFAtZGQ3MFRYeEZtY1o4d2FMWXRHdjZjRDR6alpVMzhHTmlBWjBEUFZMQXZqenpiVXppYjNXLXZzT1B0MTYzRWQ1aDMzMC16TkVKX2x0NDRpTF92ZlpBSUVHWHBKUkIwQUxP): OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta have poached 22 professors from top universities in 2026; Google [lost two AI experts to Anthropic](https://news.google.).
- [Microsoft’s carbon emissions rose 25%](https://www.theverge.com/tech/963728/microsoft-sustainability-report-2026) in 2025 to 34 million metric tons, driven by AI infrastructure expansion.

**Watch next:** The interplay between OpenAI’s leadership shakeup and its GPT-5.6 rollout will determine its IPO trajectory; Tesla’s reaction to New Jersey’s sensor mandate could reshape autonomous vehicle regulation nationwide; and the AI ROI debate — quantified at $3 trillion — remains unresolved.

sports.zh:
**🚀 世界杯半决赛对阵出炉，法国强势晋级；英格兰迎战挪威前遭遇伤病与心理战；姆巴佩失点后仍高效，Klopp爆料十年追星史。虎扑社区热议巴西爆冷出局、马刺连胜与C罗地位之争。羽毛球名宿陈宏、李永波、高崚再成话题。篮球圈关注一位隔扣过詹姆斯的球员彻底告别NBA。**

- **法国2-0摩洛哥挺进四强**，姆巴佩点球踢飞后打入本届第8球，[BBC称这支法国队可能是史上最强](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gy74978myo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)。[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/france-vs-morocco/report/549862)详细复盘了姆巴佩如何“甩掉”罚丢点球的阴影。
- **英格兰1/4决赛前遭打击**——后卫格伊腿筋轻伤可能缺席，赖斯感染生病（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3eyqdwq392o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）；挪威前锋哈兰德则施压称“压力全在英格兰一边”（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cj3gd8rg628o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。
- **克洛普回忆十年前签姆巴佩失败**：他曾与姆巴佩全家乘私人飞机“绕圈飞”，[终未成功](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cpd3052gjvxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)。
- **希勒改口看好英格兰**——[“我改变主意了，我们可能真能赢”](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cz6vz34yv82o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)。
- **国内赛场**：上海申花1-1英博，吴曦点球扳平（[虎扑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBwR1JhcXFIWkxvazluS1dhSGJYc1E0VUVrVDNUQlp5TVhfT1EtZjNRZGljZ1dScEpuVWpzV2Z6V2ZOZlRfa2RMY3RPdm1HMEZsd1Y2dC1JVFhuRGRXLVBob19uc2laV25NZV9IV3pWLTNOdw)）。
- **虎扑炸锅**：巴西0-1挪威止步16强，[MSN报道](https://news.google.)；“娶张雨霏要多少彩礼”帖引发财力和流量讨论（[虎扑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE94VnkwSjdBTk5MNmdycWZMdzJwenhfb29wZjNxNlBPUEYxX2FCX1RiS1h5eDlYNFcta1hSZUFfeGNGUHdWOEN6ZFVjekJfUmtRWjNrcUY2MzFsWlpmU0tlOUtXSi1aeDY3NzNjV2NzWG9LQQ)）。
- **篮球**：一位曾隔扣詹姆斯的球员（疑似法国前锋）以3年1200万欧元签约欧洲，[基本确定不回NBA](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxPLXNRNFJoYm1aZUluUjI3aHpZcTZfYU42Z2QycXo3TmtTNmhkUFdudmJPcHd5a1B4YlhDYm9ZcDB4bVFZbmk4RHZvanJMbzZWSVNTQ0NiZzR1TjdGTXVFeDRSSFNhTGtfZHVtMVl0cVhrNlFlOWZDRUdQV09iX0RNaktwempVdWxEdC1CTUN3)。

**📌 后续观察**：世界杯四强战即将打响，英格兰能否顶住哈兰德冲击？姆巴佩能否继续刷新进球纪录？羽毛球国羽名宿的“退圈后生活”折射出体制内外的不同选择，值得体育产业研究者注意。虎扑社区的C罗“保5争3”讨论与巴西出局叠加，或将引发球迷关于“后梅西C罗时代”的长期争论。
sports.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by World Cup action, with France booking a semi-final spot and England preparing for a crucial quarter-final against Norway. Meanwhile, the Badminton world sees a wave of nostalgia as former Chinese stars resurface in the news, while Hupu forums buzz with hot takes on basketball, esports, and legacy debates. Here is the essential briefing for sports decision-makers.

- **France cruise into semi-finals, Mbappe shakes off penalty miss** – Kylian Mbappe scored his eighth goal of the tournament as France beat Morocco 2-0, cementing their status as favourites. The performance has sparked debate on whether this iteration of Les Bleus is the best ever. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gy74978myo), [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/france-vs-morocco/report/549862))
- **England face injury and psychological warfare ahead of Norway QF** – Marc Guehi is a doubt with a hamstring issue, Declan Rice is ill, and Erling Haaland has loaded the pressure on England publicly. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3eyqdwq392o), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cj3gd8rg628o))
- **Klopp reveals failed Mbappe pursuit a decade ago** – Former Liverpool boss Jurgen Klopp disclosed he flew with Mbappe and his family in a private plane, illustrating how close the club came to signing the then-teenager. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cpd3052gjvxo))
- **Shearer changes tune: ‘England might actually win this thing’** – Alan Shearer, a long-time sceptic, now believes England have a realistic shot at the World Cup after their recent performances. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cz6vz34yv82o))
- **Badminton: Former Chinese stars in the spotlight** – Stories on Chen Hong (now coaching in Taiwan), Li Yongbo (rumoured to be farming durian in Malaysia), and Gao Ling (married a tycoon) dominate the badminton desk, providing off-court colour. ([Sina via Google News Badminton](https://news.google.), [Sina](https://news.google.))
- **Hupu communities: NBA debates, World Cup upsets, and esports excitement** – The forum is abuzz with Brazil’s shock exit to Norway, the Spurs’ winning streak, and a hypothetical Cristiano Ronaldo legacy question. ([MSN](https://news.google.), [MSN](https://news.google.))
- **Basketball: A former NBA dunker signs €12M deal in Europe, likely ending his NBA return hopes** – The player who once dunked on LeBron James has reportedly signed a three-year, €12 million contract overseas, signaling a definitive shift in his career trajectory. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxPLXNRNFJoYm1aZUluUjI3aHpZcTZfYU42Z2QycXo3TmtTNmhkUFdudmJPcHd5a1B4YlhDYm9ZcDB4bVFZbmk4RHZvanJMbzZWSVNTQ0NiZzR1TjdGTXVFeDRSSFNhTGtfZHVtMVl0cVhrNlFlOWZDRUdQV09iX0RNaktwempVdWxEdC1CTUN3))

**Watch next:** The England vs. Norway quarter-final on Saturday will be the headline event for global football fans. Meanwhile, Wimbledon semi-finals featuring Novak Djokovic and Jannik Sinner are set to draw tennis attention, and the BWF World Tour Finals approach.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐板块呈现三大趋势：K-pop 明星行程冲突与合约变动频发，AI 深度伪造肖像与声音引发行业联合抵制，中国市场则陷入“灾情冷遇、明星霸屏”的舆论争议。中国真人互动影游出海突围，而好莱坞也迎来动画恐怖喜剧与经典重制新动向。

- [IVE 成员 Gaeul 因行程冲突缺席香港 TIMA 颁奖礼](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853683wpp/ives-gaeul-to-be-absent-from-2026-tmelive-international-music-awards-tima-due-to-scheduling-conflict) —— 韩流入华遇阻？八月底香港演出背后的档期博弈引人关注。
- [IU 与李钟硕确认四年恋情结束](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853684wpp/breaking-iu-and-lee-jong-suk-confirm-breakup) —— 韩国顶级情侣分手，双方经纪公司确认“保持好同事关系”。
- [SAG-AFTRA 建议会员退出 Meta AI 功能以保护肖像](https://deadline.com/2026/07/sag-aftra-recommends-members-opt-out-meta-ai-feature-1236979025/) —— 好莱坞工会率先对抗生成式 AI 滥用，Meta Muse 工具引发隐私海啸。
- [周星驰《功夫女足》领跑暑期档但大盘仍缺大片](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE5YMWxydjBzeGdpRlJkaFp6QmxvNmZpOVdVd1I5cUVoUjBPNlR5dlNobnlsU2tWVDhLMG1JUWEwZkNUUGpYbW5ZdQ) —— 超百部电影集结，市场期待爆款提振。
- [中国真人互动影游刷屏海外](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOdHRxR3ZMRTlFbUs3OGJmTlhZRXR1ZzhPS2djeWZvYzNSajJxMFFRMmlreERzWjNxV00wTHVYdHgtMHQyaTVRNm53Z1ZBdUFPMFZwTWVER2l3R0JsNmtqUXJIVnc1MTZqMUV2UmpWV1NZOUd1Z3Z1dVQ0WTg0YjdMVVpkZTk4M3BxZGRXcQ) —— 影视圈新风向？交互式内容能否续写短剧神话。
- [王源胸肌热搜登顶，粉丝改口叫“王总”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE11cEtYV1A5NEZ0RGwycHlzQUh6SkNlODRTZnlIV1AwN0U0dTlXU1F6dlpBak5abWRrb1M3N01Nc0JVRGs4S3BEVzVpcHRYZ2FFWkI1ckpoWWRmYkVXbldLanlEc3RVWWlmcTQxV3hmRWs) —— 偶像转型标签战，大众对“成熟感”的审美转变。
- [广西洪灾上不了热搜，明星裤裆那点事却霸屏](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFBTeGJvWkQ3Uk1ITERtWkhWOVg5bWZLMWhwLVIzeEdEN3B4YzV4ZXRxS0RWbzlSSndxb1BkTVduN3JxTXZLbEQzMjdLcURqM052OE9mbW1YeU5IMV81QnVmX0J6SFg3X2g1TUcwYw) —— 媒体伦理争议持续，公众对娱乐至死的反思升温。

**后续观察：** 明日重点跟踪 AI 肖像权纠纷的连锁反应，尤其是 Meta 是否回应工会诉求；韩国恋综与偶像团体分手潮的后续影响；中国暑期档能否靠《功夫女足》或真人互动影游打破沉闷。
entertainment.en:
The past 24 hours in entertainment were marked by major industry shifts and celebrity news. K-pop faced a scheduling shake-up with IVE's Gaeul bowing out of TIMA, while the IU–Lee Jong Suk breakup dominated Korean headlines. In Hollywood, the AI frontier heated up as SAG-AFTRA pushed back against Meta's image tools, and Anthony Hopkins surprised with a classical music debut. Chinese entertainment saw Stephen Chow's new film lead summer buzz alongside rising AI concerns, while Weibo erupted over fan-driven moments.

- **IVE's Gaeul to Miss TIMA** – A last-minute scheduling conflict pulls Gaeul from the August 23 awards in Hong Kong, raising questions about group dynamics and fan expectations. [Read more](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853683wpp/ives-gaeul-to-be-absent-from-2026-tmelive-international-music-awards-tima-due-to-scheduling-conflict)
- **IU and Lee Jong Suk Break Up** – After four years, the power couple officially split, confirmed by both agencies. The news is already trending across Asia. [Details](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853684wpp/breaking-iu-and-lee-jong-suk-confirm-breakup)
- **SAG-AFTRA vs. Meta AI** – The union advises members to opt out of Meta's Muse Image tool to protect their likeness, signaling a new front in the AI rights battle. [Report](https://deadline.com/2026/07/sag-aftra-recommends-members-opt-out-meta-ai-feature-1236979025/)
- **Anthony Hopkins Turns Composer** – The Oscar winner signs with Decca Classics for a debut album of his original compositions, conducted by Gustavo Dudamel. [Listen](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/anthony-hopkins-decca-classics-life-is-a-dream-album-1236806236/)
- **Chinese Interactive Games Go Global** – A surge in Chinese interactive film games is making waves overseas, potentially reshaping the entertainment landscape. [Analysis](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOdHRxR3ZMRTlFbUs3OGJmTlhZRXR1ZzhPS2djeWZvYzNSajJxMFFRMmlreERzWjNxV00wTHVYdHgtMHQyaTVRNm53Z1ZBdUFPMFZwTWVER2l3R0JsNmtqUXJIVnc1MTZqMUV2UmpWV1NZOUd1Z3Z1dVQ0WTg0YjdMVVpkZTk4M3BxZGRXcQ)
- **Stephen Chow's 'Kung Fu Women's Football' Leads Summer Reel** – The film tops pre-release buzz, but analysts note a lack of blockbuster depth in the overall lineup. [Coverage](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE5YMWxydjBzeGdpRlJkaFp6QmxvNmZpOVdVd1I5cUVoUjBPNlR5dlNobnlsU2tWVDhLMG1JUWEwZkNUUGpYbW5ZdQ)
- **Wang Yuan's Chest Muscles Top Weibo Charts** – The idol's fitness moment sparks fan frenzy, demonstrating the power of niche celebrity moments in Chinese social media. [Trending](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE11cEtYV1A5NEZ0RGwycHlzQUh6SkNlODRTZnlIV1AwN0U0dTlXU1F6dlpBak5abWRrb1M3N01Nc0JVRGs4S3BEVzVpcHRYZ2FFWkI1ckpoWWRmYkVXbldLanlEc3RVWWlmcTQxV3hmRWs)

**Watch next:** The Moana live-action box office performance (now tracking [pre-release metrics](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/moana-box-office-test-disney-live-action-dwayne-johnson-1236643385/)) will gauge Disney's live-action revival strength. Meanwhile, the IU–Lee Jong Suk fallout may shift brand endorsements and drama casting in Korea.

美股.zh:
美股本周焦点落在芯片与地缘。SK海力士以265亿美元融资登陆纳斯达克，创外国公司IPO纪录，市场正评估其能否摆脱“韩国折价”。与此同时，美伊局势虽表面紧张但油价已因“可控”预期回调2.2%。美联储主席Warsh公布五大政策工作组名单，a16z的Marc Andreessen与沃尔玛CEO Doug McMillon入选，释放政策改革信号。

- **[SK Hynix raises $26.5bn in mega US share sale](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gym70r0y4o)** — 如果首日表现坚挺，将削弱韩国折价叙事；反之可能拖累整个亚洲芯片板块。
- **[A huge trade just happened on the Nasdaq 100. Bulls are taking notice](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/a-huge-trade-just-happened-on-the-nasdaq-100-bulls-are-taking-notice)** — 超大QQQ期权押注暗示机构看好科技股突破前高。
- **[Anduril CEO says it's bad to IPO in ‘middle of a hype cycle’](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/anduril-ceo-ipo-defense.html)** — 国防科技公司估值达610亿美元却延迟上市，反映一级市场对估值泡沫的警惕。

整体来看，科技多头情绪仍在，但伊朗风险与美联储人事变动可能带来短期扰动。
美股.en:
US equities are digesting a blockbuster week, with the Nasdaq 100's largest ever QQQ trade suggesting tech bulls are positioning for new highs. The SK Hynix $26.5bn Nasdaq debut dominates headlines as the largest foreign IPO, directly testing the 'Korea discount' narrative. Meanwhile, Fed Chair Warsh's task forces signal potential monetary policy evolution, and US-Iran tensions remain a key overhang.

- **SK Hynix raises $26.5bn in US offering** – the stock starts trading Friday. This is the biggest foreign listing on Nasdaq, giving US investors direct exposure to the AI memory boom. [MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/sk-hynix-is-about-to-hit-the-u-s-market-heres-what-to-know-about-the-deal-1c873fa4?mod=mw_rss_topstories) [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/sk-hynix-debuts-on-nasdaq-will-that-bridge-its-korea-discount-.html)
- **A huge bullish trade on Nasdaq 100 QQQ** – the largest single block trade in the ETF hints that institutions are betting on tech recovery. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/a-huge-trade-just-happened-on-the-nasdaq-100-bulls-are-taking-notice.html)
- **Kevin Warsh names Fed task force members** including Marc Andreessen and Doug McMillon, indicating a push for modernizing the Fed's approach to regulation and digital assets. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/kevin-warsh-names-members-of-his-federal-reserve-task-forces-including-marc-andreessen-doug-mcmillan.html) [Fed](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260709a.htm)
- **Anduril CEO warns against IPO 'middle of hype cycle'** despite $61bn valuation – signals caution in defense tech valuations. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/anduril-ceo-ipo-defense.html)
- **Prediction markets raise insider trading concerns** – Goldman and other firms are updating policies to address this new risk frontier. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/prediction-markets-spark-insider-trading-fears-how-firms-are-responding.html)

**Signal:** The SK Hynix debut and the large QQQ trade suggest a bullish tilt, but geopolitics (Iran/ceasefire) and potential Fed policy shifts keep risk alive. Monitor oil prices and defense stocks for near-term volatility.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲正同时面对能源缺口与产业转型压力。ECB 6月会议纪要显示官员无法忽视能源冲击，拉加德公开呼吁创建欧洲安全资产以削弱对美债的依赖。大众汽车裁员10万的计划引发全国抗议，显示汽车业电动化转型的代价正在显现。天然气库存低位（不足100天）令冬季风险提前定价。

- **[ECB’s Lagarde calls for a European safe asset to rival US Treasuries](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5uZGFHT2tXV3Y0SEhGdHVDS1FIOHRnc3Bjd0RGQlJ6Y2tZemk4QXBBaWNVVXdyVVpRVG5tbUdGb2R5QzhjRmhIYk9JbUdoYVlfQ0dqLU9OUFVZLUx4TDJyT205Nkd5RGttX1ZZdk9naUduYmMxbUVJSWs1emdoZw)** — 若推进，将改变全球债券市场格局，但成员国政治协调仍是障碍。
- **[VW workers protest in Germany over proposed job cuts and factory closures](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/09/vw-protests-germany-proposed-job-cuts-factory-closures)** — 涉及10万岗位，反映欧洲最大经济体正经历结构性阵痛。
- **[Europe Faces Fresh Volatility After Iran Flare-Up, Officials Say](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOX29jNzlrVEkybnhoWGJTdG9JZWNCbG05cm45aFBhMG1YTVVSTkFDZWRtWlFMdXN0RTNhOHduTnlHVFN4YVFjdmdSbU9JdHY3TUpYQ2U2ZXlOXzY3aUxkbzhmQWs4M3NHbHYyVjRKNExjRzdnWmpLTzBuQzV3YUJKVTM5VHVUQTROZVZZNldNWWk2UGFSWWJWRjJDeWZURG85aWJFMWY2WVl2NHRyTmFkSXZKVW4)** — 伊朗波动直接影响欧洲能源安全，天然气价格或再次走高。

结论：欧洲短期内难摆脱“能源+转型”双重困境，ECB需要更创新的工具来维持市场信心。
欧洲经济.en:
Europe faces multiple headwinds: an impending natural gas supply crunch with less than 100 days to build inventories, renewed geopolitical risk from US-Iran flare-ups, and domestic unrest over industrial restructuring (VW protests). The ECB is actively pushing for a European safe asset to reduce dependency on US Treasuries, while Spain proposes fresh debt plans.

- **ECB's Lagarde calls for a European safe asset** to rival US Treasuries, emphasizing the need for fiscal integration. Spain pitches new debt plan. [Crypto Briefing](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5uZGFHT2tXV3Y0SEhGdHVDS1FIOHRnc3Bjd0RGQlJ6Y2tZemk4QXBBaWNVVXdyVVpRVG5tbUdGb2R5QzhjRmhIYk9JbUdoYVlfQ0dqLU9OUFVZLUx4TDJyT205Nkd5RGttX1ZZdk9naUduYmMxbUVJSWs1emdoZw) [Euronews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPNDRNSEF1MVByRmRNZzJqOE5vWDlFamJ1UnFrOVU3UnlOOV9FclFVTUR3VW0ybEZBeTNOZy1zWFF2Y2xBaXdLckR1TFdpR3FEZ18wRmIzNDFTeUk1YTNmSXhaTDgtOTNJTFZxZlNfLXUxUHptaTlmaGZfLUN1WENtQ0I5WGRpRTBKbVFUZ1R3dG00bXd1aHFEMWVGenZaQVU4Vzc1QklVSExCZTJJVkNReXlFZ3lPMkV1Y1ZMNE8zdw)
- **Europe's natural gas inventories critically low** – fewer than 100 days to address. Combined with Iran tensions, energy prices could spike. [Seeking Alpha](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPRDJabmN6NHZCRzVMU2plMjhCTVBLb19WTkJZSDBfd3prUFlWRy1aZlpualhDQzlpQTBWNWlhQnBhWVgtWlF3NGlERmZMNUpRb3MxZ05zaG5XakRNTE5PYW1qMTNGby1IYWc5MWltZUtzMW5PTEwtWmlGZWpDYk1ITWhvX3V2VjluNnFWTWVmb1JqR2dBaEVzOE1LbVJsVEdSVERTS0tmM1EyUzZ1U2tJaTBURlhyS3lqak9WcHRWWF84dHhMNTVoZ3ln)
- **VW workers protest across 18 German sites** over proposed 100,000 job cuts and factory closures – a major test for Europe's largest automaker's transformation plan. [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/09/vw-protests-germany-proposed-job-cuts-factory-closures)
- **Europe's China risk is misjudged**, argues a new analysis – trade deficits don't capture supply chain dependencies. [economy.ac](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE1BZldZdEUyVWotejhFb3R3UjQ1dzVGTk5VZ29hV0RNeUNFcmpCamxSVG1nRmJUd2RYUVZIQjQ0UzR2c0k0ekdqX0s4M09ROGVhTml6ZGZwR2hUQQ)
- **EU border checks face overhaul calls** as Greek airports boss labels system 'unpleasant and dangerous.' Operational impacts on tourism and logistics. [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/09/eu-unpleasant-and-dangerous-border-checks-need-overhaul-says-greek-airports-boss)

**Signal:** The convergence of energy risk, social unrest, and geopolitical shock could pressure ECB policy and eurozone bond spreads. Watch for emergency gas procurement announcements and further ECB safe-asset proposals.

中国经济.zh:
中国股市今日呈现结构性行情：A股医药板块爆发带动沪指回升，港股则受制于小盘流动性枯竭与AI概念降温。小米宣布SUV新系列Sky Nomad及长续航电池技术，在电动车红海继续加码。央行通过扩大人民币业务设施额度巩固香港离岸中心地位。

- **[A股午评：沪指半日涨0.76%，创新药、医疗服务板块集体爆发](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5PQ2xuOGVPdlh3QXhWS05xY1VwSlBMNTVSR1d1WkQwRjVPV0hUY0RkYWZ3bkw5NlNLMUNMdFBHLUtVQ3lVVWZlNFhrTU80X2FnWmFMdTV5SUpPLXZyMkE)** — 医药板块的可持续性取决于后续政策落地与业绩兑现。
- **[Xiaomi preps for fierce EV race with new SUV line, long-range battery tech](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-evs/article/3359985/xiaomi-preps-fierce-ev-race-new-suv-line-long-range-battery-tech)** — 小米从手机跨界汽车已初见成效，但SUV市场竞争更为激烈。
- **[Small-cap IPOs struggle in Hong Kong amid lack of AI megadeals](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3359991/small-cap-ipos-struggle-hong-kong-amid-lack-ai-megadeals)** — 本周13只新股中5只破发，显示资金向头部项目集中。

关注点：长鑫存储上海IPO能否复制SK海力士的融资热度，以及港交所人民币设施能否改善流动性。
中国经济.en:
China's markets saw selective strength: A-share healthcare and corn stocks surged, while Hong Kong's luxury hotels rebounded strongly. The memory chip sector is a focal point, with CXMT's $4.3bn Shanghai IPO and SK Hynix's US listing reshaping the landscape. Uniqlo's double-digit profit growth in China defies sluggish consumption, and Xiaomi launches a new EV SUV line.

- **CXMT sets Shanghai IPO subscription date** – raising at least $4.3bn, it would be the second-largest on the Star Market. This positions China's DRAM maker against SK Hynix's US debut. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3359955/chinas-top-dram-maker-sets-date-us43b-shanghai-ipo-amid-memory-boom)
- **A-share midday rally: Shanghai Composite +0.76%** led by healthcare (vaccine ETF +6%) and agriculture (corn +2%). A new stock surged 10x on debut, reflecting retail exuberance. [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5PQ2xuOGVPdlh3QXhWS05xY1VwSlBMNTVSR1d1WkQwRjVPV0hUY0RkYWZ3bkw5NlNLMUNMdFBHLUtVQ3lVVWZlNFhrTU80X2FnWmFMdTV5SUpPLXZyMkE) [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE91bWRZUXh0OTIxRFZnMHU4bUlVeG1DNlU1OVVNNEpaRWstSm1pVWVKYTJIYWlwTFNNeWhOanE0Mno2YzBSa1haeEVDdXVJTzF5YXl1aGJvQTZ0SmtMLWhIOA)
- **Xiaomi announces new SUV line 'Sky Nomad'** with long-range battery, intensifying the EV race. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-evs/article/3359985/xiaomi-preps-fierce-ev-race-new-suv-line-long-range-battery-tech)
- **Hong Kong IPO market shows divergence**: small caps struggle (5 of 13 broke issue price), while Zhipu AI fell 10%. Michael Burry sees opportunity from Korea's AI-memory unwind. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3359991/small-cap-ipos-struggle-hong-kong-amid-lack-ai-megadeals) [Yahoo Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNQm1vLWtZLTJZTVl0MUNDa3N4VTZNN25rVWVRd25PZlpKR1NDUXRjdHNkTEF0OElrMnlPQ1RHVzdiRG90UHlVUWdJR1FwejBfeDByTHVZcDhINTY5WW9YLUtsaXNfYzNDLVBtNHlfS1pFRVdScjdodzFkZmh3RWhMQ1dNM2JPdmdIbFZKSWIySjV0VFpqdXpJMg)
- **Uniqlo posts double-digit profit growth in China** despite weak consumption, driven by summer product demand. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3360017/uniqlo-defies-sluggish-china-market-double-digit-profit-growth)
- **Hong Kong launches enlarged RMB Business Facility** to boost yuan internationalization, increasing quota 150%. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3359981/how-rmb-business-facility-will-help-consolidate-hong-kongs-financial-role)

**Signal:** China's chip sector is gaining momentum with dual IPOs (CXMT in Shanghai, SK Hynix in US), but small-cap HK IPOs signal liquidity constraints. Watch A-share rotation into healthcare and agriculture, and the impact of CXMT's pricing on global memory stocks.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
社区热度集中在三条主线：粮食安全（玉米板块异动、种业抢筹）、医药（疫苗ETF领涨6.08%）、以及散户投机情绪（首日10倍股再现）。融资盘数据显示中际旭创单日获65亿元买入，AI光模块仍是最受杠杆资金青睐的方向。

- **[【板块异动】全球粮价中枢要抬升？玉米板块狂飙2%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE4zYmRSQ2RqVXZDVUMzMGJfTUwyQU1XUktNS0R2R2g3Zjd2QVZWRVlqUVNJZTl1T1pXd3BOOGRHa0ZlVHJKQmNlbkI3Qkw5Zl83YS1aQklZb1U0eGVJMFE)** — 地缘冲突与极端天气炒作推高农产品预期，但需警惕资金快进快出。
- **[ETF午评：疫苗ETF领涨6.08%，科创创业ETF领跌2.46%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFBTd3lIdmFNbUhJdFNhS0VVcWViaUl2dU9nSlpjTHIzbE55T251MUhmNEJTVUJnTlh1aW94azdUaEFaMW04UWRHTTd1QWI1VUxEZE5SSEJ5WVFBelpVUzlqSA)** — 资金明显从科技转向防御型医药板块。

同花顺社区动态.en:

Institutional financing data shows heavy buying in 中际旭创 (65bn yuan in margin purchases), indicating strong conviction in AI-related stocks. The community is also tracking commodity prices like palm oil.

欧美.zh:
美伊在哈梅内伊下葬日互袭，北约峰会刚刚结束即面临战火重燃的新考验。美国中央司令部称打击了90个伊朗目标，伊朗卫生部通报14人死亡（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz75zjj5wp8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。与此同时，美国批准乌克兰本土生产‘爱国者’导弹，北约峰会罕见释放武器授权信号（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/10/zelenskyy-urges-urgent-efforts-in-ukraine-to-start-patriot-production?traffic_source=rss)）。
- 西班牙阿尔梅里亚省野火致12死6伤，南欧热浪持续（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c8e2382jk7jo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。
- 希腊F-16战斗机在扎金索斯机场迫降焚烧，跑道关闭，旅游业安全受关注（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czrxz18720eo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。
- 乌克兰特工谋杀案犯翻供，两名与乌安全局有联系的人被控在摩纳哥杀害女子（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cpv3e8y39j7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。
- 民主党候选人普莱特纳因性侵指控暂停参选关键参议员席位（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9v229434p2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。
收束：冲突与灾害叠加，欧洲安全与旅游双线承压，需关注北约后续行动与伊朗报复的连锁反应。
欧美.en:
The US and Iran exchanged fresh airstrikes overnight, with Centcom claiming 90 targets hit and Iran retaliating against Gulf allies. Ukraine continued its campaign against Russian naval assets near Crimea, while a Spanish wildfire killed 12. The Gaza humanitarian crisis deepened as an aid worker who organized World Cup screenings was killed by an Israeli strike. Meanwhile, a Ukrainian agent accused of murder changed his story, and the Monaco bomb suspect case took a new twist.

- **US-Iran strikes intensify**: The US launched new airstrikes, hitting 90 Iranian targets; Iran retaliated by striking US-allied Gulf Arab states. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz75zjj5wp8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/09/g-s1-132670/us-iran-strikes))
- **Ukraine targets Russian ships near Crimea**: Ukraine struck Russian fuel supplies and shipping routes, part of a broader effort to choke off Crimea. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c70yd1g67z5o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Gaza World Cup organizer killed**: Mohammed al-Wahidi, a key humanitarian figure, was killed by an Israeli strike on the eve of a World Cup match. ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/7/10/gaza-mourns-aid-worker-killed-by-israel-who-helped-them-see-the-world-cup?traffic_source=rss))
- **Spain wildfire claims 12 lives**: A blaze in Los Gallardos, Almería, left six injured amid an ongoing Southern European heatwave. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c8e2382jk7jo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Ukrainian agent changes story in Monaco bomb suspect murder**: Two men linked to Ukraine's security services are accused of killing Anastasiia Berezovska. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cpv3e8y39j7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))

**Signal:** The parallel escalations in the Middle East and Ukraine-Russia front suggest the global security environment is becoming more volatile, with potential spillover into energy markets and NATO alliance cohesion.

- BTS在托特纳姆热刺球场创下演唱会观演纪录——[Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5vT0tEZURqUGJYVklzSGRVcW83dlliYmJpa0FMSlNfWl9ELTF4ZnpMWVM1WEJRMHpQZExCQnhrWVhsRzJBamdaRmNzaWdlRUZSNjVqNjBBVQ)。

日韩.en:

Meanwhile, Japan is bracing for Typhoon Bavi, which has already caused flight and ferry cancellations. Positive economic news emerged as South Korea's BTS set a concert attendance record and vertical farming technology debuted in Tokyo. However, concerns persist over bullying in South Korea's hospitals and Apple's interest in Chinese memory chips.

**Signal:** The combination of geopolitical friction (North Korea) and natural disaster (Typhoon Bavi) will test regional resilience, while economic bright spots like BTS and vertical farming offer contrast.
