([edu.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOblBrRk9OSEhVREN5SGNQbENiR01nNkdmN3U4TS1OblBJZ01WVE0wWWVEYjdmNUpHWGJBbTlsTS1kT2RIMy12TWVOWC1VXzRBUEJsek5qbjEtZi1XRHB6SVpFQTFLY29fUmVsVEJOck8xekpCSWxibDhYdVhsYlprTU9xelBnNGx2ZHJxWGVtc2s))
- **China civil society speaks at UN Human Rights Council**: Chinese NGOs advocated on various issues at the 62nd session. ([China News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE5zUTNZU0k0ZnNNLTVmWEpLUE9oM25jcVFESUhjbDZNalFNeUN4NmlRM2JVR1VWMk56MERJdjdtZXpwX29MLXRHRkJJRkotZS1xdGgtbTRkMXJNRWZPVTlub3p1WHAtNFNR))
- **Mobile malware alert: fake education apps targeting Android users**: The National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center warned of trojans in counterfeit apps. ([The Paper](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE90eGNXT0RoZFBmZ19UbFhxdkIzclUtbXhyLWx4QWhzT2Y2dGV3NHBEdHo2NGtnX3RhOEVUMjhoS0M5UjVuRWw3SW5yS0JySHgwaXRielRxdUQtMkdmWHJHdA))
- **Multiple ministries push for retail innovation to boost consumer confidence**: New measures aim to modernize retail and protect consumer rights. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFAzV3BWZE45a0lUUV9tVG4tWVozQk9hYVQ3Vk1pWlc4V3dycXlMRXpGa3UweGFTMXZtZTJMak11Qk1fVVNaWWM3eXhGUzJVZkpqcFFzdUhHNzVnbUkzVFJ4emUzVnl5YkltNmhWWXo0VmtKa2lJajJnTkljY1JuQQ))

**Signal:** China is doubling down on dual priorities of environmental sustainability and technological independence, with concrete policy actions that will shape domestic markets and international perceptions.

国际安全.zh:
全球安全格局在24小时内经历双重冲击：美伊冲突急剧升级，同时多国推进关键武器采购与预算调整。德国决定采购陆基“战斧”导弹，标志着北约对俄常规打击姿态的重大转变；五角大楼启动6.27亿美元激光武器项目，同时寻求转移43亿美元应对运营成本激增。这些动态表明，大国竞争与地区冲突正同步推高军事开支与技术竞速。

- **[德国采购陆基“战斧”导弹](https://www.twz.com/land/germany-to-buy-ground-launched-tomahawk-missiles)**：这是北约首次在欧洲部署陆基远程巡航导弹，直接回应俄罗斯威胁，将改变欧洲常规威慑平衡。
- **[五角大楼预算转移430亿美元](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/pentagon-seeks-to-shift-4-3b-to-pay-for-increasing-operation-and-personnel-costs/)**：从多个武器项目中抽资以支付“未预见军事需求”，反映美军在全球多点部署下的财务压力。
- **[美伊冲突：170个伊朗目标被打击](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQMXU3aVlzZThDSGVOQmpqSERlLThRdGIxV3RhV00zeEthbUp4ZktxUjhsMHRvMGZ6VjAtYUlRYjRvR184ekxuRmNnUzRFa2lRQ2ZkMWlIczFFOGdaTlA1VE9qbHMyMjdwYTdnZy1PRnp1REl3a2NNaWxBdm5JeklKSnF6YmRXcVFHZ0ZjWGQtSG5RX3JXbHhCZHRjVl9XdFdpR3c2c3VsOFQ)**——美方宣称已摧毁170个伊朗目标，但伊朗随即打击美国在四国基地，冲突规模超出预期。
- **判断**：全球军费进入新一轮增长周期，而美伊冲突的不可控性正在测试美国同时应对多个战区的资源极限。
国际安全.en:
The U.S.-Iran conflict has entered a new phase of tit-for-tat strikes, with the U.S. striking 170 Iranian targets and Iran retaliating against U.S. bases in four countries. The Pentagon is moving $4.3 billion to cover operational costs, while new weapons programs—including laser systems and a B-2 anti-ship missile capability—signal a shift in how the U.S. prepares for peer conflicts. Germany’s decision to buy ground-launched Tomahawks also marks a major NATO posture change.

- **U.S. confirms 170 Iran targets hit** in retaliation for ship attacks, escalating the conflict ([US says 170 Iran targets hit](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQMXU3aVlzZThDSGVOQmpqSERlLThRdGIxV3RhV00zeEthbUp4ZktxUjhsMHRvMGZ6VjAtYUlRYjRvR184ekxuRmNnUzRFa2lRQ2ZkMWlIczFFOGdaTlA1VE9qbHMyMjdwYTdnZy1PRnp1REl3a2NNaWxBdm5JeklKSnF6YmRXcVFHZ0ZjWGQtSG5RX3JXbHhCZHRjVl9XdFdpR3c2c3VsOFQ)).
- **Pentagon seeks to shift $4.3 billion** from weapon programs to pay for 'unforeseen military requirements' ([Pentagon seeks to shift $4.3B](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/pentagon-seeks-to-shift-4-3b-to-pay-for-increasing-operation-and-personnel-costs/)).
- **B-2 Spirit can now carry 16 anti-ship missiles**, altering the math in the Taiwan Strait scenario ([The B-2 Spirit Stealth Bomber](https://news.google.)).
- **Germany to acquire ground-launched Tomahawks**, a major shift in NATO conventional strike posture ([Germany To Buy Ground-Launched Tomahawk Missiles](https://www.twz.com/land/germany-to-buy-ground-launched-tomahawk-missiles)).
- **Pentagon launches $627M laser weapon program** to tackle cruise missiles, alongside an $86M award for next-gen systems ([Pentagon launches $627M laser weapon program](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPWU9GTmhmU2g5XzYwVl9FQlY4czFzdi1XYmVZc09vMnFwalJDRG5YVWNNa1pKZmhQUkJydkxrbWZKS29Za2ZXVVEzOTI2Sjl4Z3dZWFduRDdwX0JWTV80cTlUbGJkdjVfMlJiTjdyTmJ1RjMwQlZOYmFJekVKckxVT1N2SHFfZw)).

Signal: The escalation between the U.S. and Iran risks drawing in regional proxies and further destabilizing the Middle East, while NATO simultaneously reinforces its deterrent posture against Russia.

冲突局势.zh:
美伊冲突成为绝对焦点：特朗普宣布停火“结束”后，伊朗在24小时内打击了美国在四个国家的军事基地，美方则声称摧毁170个伊朗目标，双方互袭进入第三天。与此同时，乌克兰持续打击俄罗斯石油基础设施，马士基恢复经苏伊士运河的美东航线，红海局势有所缓和。欧洲对以色列“大卫投石索”防空系统兴趣激增，显示防空焦虑蔓延。

- **[美伊冲突进入第三天](https://www.twz.com/news-features/renewed-attacks-between-u-s-and-iran-stretch-into-third-day)**：伊朗打击范围扩大至伊拉克、叙利亚、沙特和以色列境内目标，美军反应尚不明朗，和平谈判前景渺茫。
- **[乌克兰无人机袭击俄油库与油轮](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNRm1xVW5JLVJqSlZVZU9HWXR2b29VYTdzSjQ3VjFkMzBld0p4ZHFMdDlmSWVJWDdueTVFU3RVek42N2RvajRXM09zOG02UEJTOG04ZGtCVkUwSWhleU56Zl9PVVlvaDk0bjM0X21Ga3F1MlRPMjFvWDdscGUwU1RPbG5zX3VFZi1kZEpNckNYcUZFblIwLTFZRjNCZE9PS2ZiQmhTNnpR)**——基辅持续打击俄能源设施，意图削弱俄战争经济，克里姆林宫谴责美国鼓励升级。
- **[马士基恢复苏伊士航线](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxPcjExbkdTVFRFYzFvaklqNURRMHRWRTdGRVhlNXhldVZOQ0czRDNucTQ2djJ5alk1bm5BRU03dzRycHVuWV93WExiaHJmQXVrOUlpLWpnenFORkZSdzFVaGtVVWsxdFJORHhrYmR2Vi1yX2xqdG5vOTI4Mkd4TUJ0OTE0VnN0WWVNbmZPUTA1RmZsWHB5UzFxZFhiQnBCQQ)**——红海航运逐步恢复正常，但胡塞武装威胁仍存，全球供应链风险未完全解除。
- **判断**：美伊冲突已从“报复性打击”滑向“区域战争”边缘，油价与安全成本将显著上升；而乌克兰战场的能源战与红海航运恢复形成对比，显示冲突链条的复杂性。
冲突局势.en:
The U.S.-Iran conflict is causing historic disruptions to global oil supply, with markets absorbing the loss but facing depleted strategic stocks. Meanwhile, commercial shipping is cautiously returning to the Red Sea as Maersk restores a Suez service, while Ukraine continues to target Russian oil infrastructure. Europe’s growing interest in Israel’s David’s Sling air defense system highlights shifting defense priorities.

- **World absorbs historic Iran war oil supply loss**, but depleted stocks bring risks ([World absorbs historic Iran war oil supply loss](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOeWVHWUxrcmo0VEhvMEczb0dSSTNubzhEZm1xekNqTzQ3eDlvMld2WFlqcWFxY0ZHM1o2dXczU21SVXg3anlBSktxb0NyZXIyRFQtbnlrM2xSR2ZwdERDcVBLLVIyTUlNT0lMenRXZ0xZbGlqYS1HWlFOUXZQNVBWT2l0cUppYVU)).
- **Maersk resumes Middle East-US East Coast shipping via Suez Canal**, a sign of improving security conditions ([Maersk Resumes Middle East-US East Coast Shipping](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxPcjExbkdTVFRFYzFvaklqNURRMHRWRTdGRVhlNXhldVZOQ0czRDNucTQ2djJ5alk1bm5BRU03dzRycHVuWV93WExiaHJmQXVrOUlpLWpnenFORkZSdzFVaGtVVWsxdFJORHhrYmR2Vi1yX2xqdG5vOTI4Mkd4TUJ0OTE0VnN0WWVNbmZPUTA1RmZsWHB5UzFxZFhiQnBCQQ)).
- **Ukraine targets Russian oil depots and tankers in drone attacks**, intensifying the energy war ([Ukraine targets Russian oil depots and tankers](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNRm1xVW5JLVJqSlZVZU9HWXR2b29VYTdzSjQ3VjFkMzBld0p4ZHFMdDlmSWVJWDdueTVFU3RVek42N2RvajRXM09zOG02UEJTOG04ZGtCVkUwSWhleU56Zl9PVVlvaDk0bjM0X21Ga3F1MlRPMjFvWDdscGUwU1RPbG5zX3VFZi1kZEpNckNYcUZFblIwLTFZRjNCZE9PS2ZiQmhTNnpR)).
- **Europe’s interest in David’s Sling is surging** as air defense concerns grow, says Israel’s missile director ([Europe's interest in David's Sling](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQTEljVXdHb1Fmb2tyelJRMzNLbGdqN0k0ZDE1ZDBOUGxvQXJiSFdIMXJaTjZKYkxxbWJzSWRtbXdjMGJGMXJiVHpDbUpQTWdqbWJ5WWdZVzgtQ0Z5ZWtBVjlma2FwWWJmcEFLa0RISFZMbnVaem5sQU42ZTA4Z3R1WEhUOWZHNmZEeWh6Z0QtRXVpQmJWQ1dadGRRQnQzRlE)).
- **Israel pushes to clear sea munitions** as part of a global push to protect waters ([AP Exclusive: Inside Israel’s push to clear sea munitions](https://news.google.)).

Signal: The dual pressures of war-driven oil supply loss and gradual resumption of Red Sea shipping illustrate the fragile balance between conflict and commerce, with Europe pivoting to new air defense partnerships.

中国军情.zh:
中国军情在24小时内呈现多线并行：核潜艇向太平洋发射战略导弹引发国际分析热潮；日本高官宣称出兵台海；中俄秘密军事论坛曝光；国防部批评日本将军事扩张伸向太空。此外，美众院中国问题委员会施压NBA/NHL与阿里巴巴关系，商务部回应美方将部分中企列入“中国军事企业清单”。整体而言，中国在核威慑、台海与太空领域同时展示强硬姿态。

- **[中国海军水下发射战略导弹](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9ZeTBSQlRnY095SWpTU1BvdFRzTFRnX2x3aEh0ZGFBVTNqV1pBcW0yZzRCczllR0I0N3VEOW05V3lNQlF5WDlzSlBFaVJha3NQbWdRcGZyemZNRGs)**：风闻分析认为，此次测试释放了“持续海上核威慑”信号，与海军舰艇编队访越形成软硬对比。
- **[高市叫嚣出兵台海](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTFA0bjA2NWlMSnk1b3g3aXhNSWE4UExvbTJSSzkwT05tTjdFeW1wd0hydjljOWs0Y1lvNExoUkRPOV92a0V6bTF2RFBkYw)**：外媒评论称若日本动武，中国民众无需动员即可形成反击意志，台海紧张升温。
- **[中俄定期举行秘密军事论坛](https://news.google.)**：法媒援引消息称中俄定期举行秘密军事论坛，协调战略立场，引发西方对军事联盟深化的担忧。
- **[国防部批日本太空军事扩张](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFBDaDhvcUtOYnYwYTZQSnJKMzRyRVhybkRLTUVRZlNSU3o5MlBWNHJvWnZqcmFNR3loWlFRSFBBd0FjTGtVSUFpazRUYjFWWHJyN3Q3clN4c2RTWHA0cXpLMzI1aWdncGZR)**：中国国防部明确警告日本将军事扩张伸向太空，太空军控议题升温。
- **判断**：中国正通过核威慑展示与区域存在同步推进“反介入/区域拒止”体系升级，台海与太空成为下一阶段博弈重点。
中国军情.en:
China’s military modernization is on full display with the J-15T’s combat debut from the Fujian carrier and a strategic SLBM test into the Pacific. Domestically, state media tout the Navy’s progress while pushing back on the South China Sea arbitration award. A Japanese official’s rhetoric on Taiwan and reported China-Russia secret military forums add layers to the region’s security dynamics.

- **Chinese J-15T launches with four anti-ship missiles for first time** from the carrier Fujian, demonstrating increased strike capability ([Chinese J-15 Fighter Seen Launching From A Carrier With Four Anti-Ship Missiles](https://www.twz.com/sea/chinese-j-15-fighter-seen-launching-from-a-carrier-with-four-anti-ship-missiles-for-first-time)).
- **PLAN submarine-launched ballistic missile test into the Pacific** signals shift toward continuous at-sea deterrence, with analysis highlighting the maturing sea-based nuclear deterrent ([Analysis: China’s Pacific SLBM Test Signals Shift Toward Continuous At-Sea Deterrence](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/china-pacific-slbm-test-casd-nuclear-deterrence/)).
- **Japanese political figure calls for dispatch of troops to Taiwan Strait**, prompting Chinese state media to respond that 'no mobilization needed' to counter Japan ([高市叫嚣出兵台海，外媒：若对日动手，中国人无需动员](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTFA0bjA2NWlMSnk1b3g3aXhNSWE4UExvbTJSSzkwT05tTjdFeW1wd0hydjljOWs0Y1lvNExoUkRPOV92a0V6bTF2RFBkYw)).
- **China and Russia have held regular secret military forums** for several years, according to French media ([法国世界报 - 几年来，中国和俄罗斯一直定期举行秘密军事论坛](https://news.google.)).
- **People’s Daily rejects South China Sea arbitration award** as 'illegal and invalid from the start' ([人民日报寰宇平：所谓“南海仲裁案裁决”，自始非法无效](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE92TmNSUjNPRWt3eGt1ZGlSUDM0anhaeXBEbl9mMlpucHU0Y25wMjN1VkRzQTVteWtjbnp0TWRyZnF2em5sTnhGR0YwbDdXdkYtSi10QlRoNkQ2THBXbUFCNQ)).

Signal: China is simultaneously showcasing new naval strike and deterrence capabilities while hardening its diplomatic stance on Taiwan and the South China Sea, against a backdrop of deepening military coordination with Russia.

海军与印太.zh:
印太海军动态集中于中国战略核潜艇测试的深远影响，以及美英在北极与欧洲方向的部署调整。中国SLBM测试被解读为迈向“持续海上威慑”的关键一步；英国领导的联合远征军承诺在北极保持“持续海上存在”以应对俄罗斯；美国“尼米兹”号航母抵达诺福克准备换防，而“林肯”号在中东已连续部署超200天。欧洲电磁轨道炮首次野外试射成功，法国加强自主水雷对抗工业。

- **[中国太平洋SLBM测试分析](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/china-pacific-slbm-test-casd-nuclear-deterrence/)**：海军新闻分析指出，此次测试表明中国核潜艇已具备在太平洋中段发射能力，向“持续海上威慑”转型，对美日反导系统构成新挑战。
- **[英军牵头联合远征军承诺北极持续存在](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/09/u-k-partners-commit-to-persistent-maritime-presence-to-counter-russia-in-high-north)**：10国JEF同意实施“海上命题-联合远征军”计划，旨在北极、北大西洋和波罗的海常态化部署，直接对抗俄罗斯在极地的军事活动。
- **[欧洲电磁轨道炮首次野外试射](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/isl-european-electromagnetic-railgun-free-flight-test/)**：法德圣路易斯研究所6月29日成功进行自由飞行测试，标志着欧洲电磁武器从实验室走向实战验证。
- **[“林肯”号航母连续部署超200天](https://www.twz.com/sea/supercarrier-uss-abraham-lincoln-passes-200-consecutive-days-at-sea-mark)**：中东紧张局势下，该舰无港口休整的记录凸显美军部署疲劳与维护风险。
- **判断**：中国核威慑能力向“海基化”转型与北约北极反制同步推进，印太-欧洲军事联动正在加速；电磁轨道炮等新概念武器进入测试阶段，未来海战规则可能被改写。
海军与印太.en:
Naval operational readiness remains a central focus, with the USS Abraham Lincoln setting a 200-day continuous deployment record and the USS Nimitz arriving in Norfolk for its final homeport shift. China’s SLBM test underscores the growing challenge to U.S. maritime dominance, while the UK-led Joint Expeditionary Force commits to a persistent presence in the High North to counter Russia. New technologies—from European railguns to autonomous mine countermeasures—are reshaping naval warfare.

- **USS Abraham Lincoln surpasses 200 consecutive days at sea** operating in the Middle East with no port call since December 2025 ([Supercarrier USS Abraham Lincoln Passes 200 Consecutive Days At Sea Mark](https://www.twz.com/sea/supercarrier-uss-abraham-lincoln-passes-200-consecutive-days-at-sea-mark)).
- **USS Nimitz arrives in Norfolk** ahead of final homeport shift after participating in the International Naval Review ([USS Nimitz Arrives in Norfolk](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/09/uss-nimitz-arrives-in-norfolk-for-homeport-shift)).
- **China’s Pacific SLBM test signals continuous at-sea deterrence** and a maturing sea-based nuclear deterrent ([Analysis: China’s Pacific SLBM Test Signals Shift Toward Continuous At-Sea Deterrence](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/china-pacific-slbm-test-casd-nuclear-deterrence/)).
- **UK-led JEF commits to persistent maritime presence** in the High North, North Atlantic, and Baltic to counter Russia ([U.K., Partners Commit to ‘Persistent Maritime Presence’ to Counter Russia in High North](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/09/u-k-partners-commit-to-persistent-maritime-presence-to-counter-russia-in-high-north)).
- **ISL conducts first open-range test of European electromagnetic railgun**, marking a critical step from lab to field ([ISL Conducts First Open-Range Test Shot of European Electromagnetic Railgun](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/isl-european-electromagnetic-railgun-free-flight-test/)).

Signal: The pressure on naval forces is mounting from multiple theaters, with extended deployments, new deterrence challenges, and rapid technological advances all demanding higher readiness and innovation from allied and rival navies alike.

汽车.zh:
全球电动车销量6月首破200万辆，但美国正被中欧甩开。特朗普政府的清洁能源倒退已[导致680亿美元投资蒸发](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/trump-clean-energy-rollbacks-erase-68b-in-us-investment/)，而新泽西州立法直击特斯拉纯视觉方案——要求Robotaxi必须配备雷达和激光雷达，[马斯克或被迫妥协](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/new-jersey-bill-tesla-camera-robotaxi/)。与此同时，车企分化明显：
- [比亚迪欧洲特供Dolphin G插混](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/byd-launches-dolphin-g-phev-65-miles-ev-range-for-32000/)，纯电续航65英里，起价3.2万美元，直接冲击欧洲市场。
- [MG宣布2027年推出半固态电池PHEV](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/mg-launch-first-phev-with-semi-solid-state-batteries-2027/)，将新电池技术率先用于插混而非纯电。
- [丰田推迟首款三排电动SUV Highlander BEV](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/toyota-delays-highlander-ev-production-first-3-row-electric-suv/)，转而在燃油/混动车型上延长生命周期。
收束：美国若持续政策摇摆，不仅投资流失，连本土巨头（丰田、特斯拉）的电气化节奏也会受拖累；反倒是中韩品牌通过灵活定价和电池创新占据主动。
汽车.en:
The automotive desk is dominated by two narratives: the global EV market’s uneven growth and the U.S. policy drag on clean energy investment. June global EV sales breached 2 million, but the U.S. share is shrinking as China surges; Trump-era rollbacks have cost $68 billion in investment. Automakers are responding with aggressive pricing (Hyundai’s 0% APR) and new products (BYD’s Europe-focused Dolphin G, MG’s semi-solid-state PHEV). Meanwhile, New Jersey’s proposed camera-only Robotaxi ban threatens Tesla’s autonomous ambitions.

- [Global EV sales hit 2 million in June – US falls behind](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/global-ev-sales-hit-2-million-in-june-and-the-us-falls-further-behind/) — the gap between leading markets widens.
- [Hyundai offers up to $10,000 off with 0% APR](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/hyundai-launches-ev-deals-0-apr-up-to-10000-off/) on EVs as summer sales event kicks off.
- [BYD launches Dolphin G PHEV for Europe](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/byd-launches-dolphin-g-phev-65-miles-ev-range-for-32000/) — 65 miles EV range, $32,000 starting price.
- [New Jersey bill would ban Tesla’s camera-only Robotaxi](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/new-jersey-bill-tesla-camera-robotaxi/) — requires lidar and radar, excluding Tesla but allowing Waymo.
- [Trump clean energy rollbacks erase $68B in US investment](https://electrek.co/2026/07/09/trump-clean-energy-rollbacks-erase-68b-in-us-investment/) — report cites 470,000 lost jobs.

**Signal:** The EV price war and regulatory divergence will separate winners from laggards; watch for Tesla’s response to the New Jersey bill and how other states follow.

AI.zh:
AI行业今日上演“离职夜”与“发版日”。OpenAI二号人物Fidji Simo因病卸任AGI负责人，转任兼职顾问——[她原定只休数周医疗假，但神经免疫问题持续更久](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/963738/openai-fidji-simo-steps-down-ceo-advisor)，让正筹备IPO和追赶Anthropic的OpenAI突然出现领导真空。不过同日发布的[GPT-5.6](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/openai-launches-its-new-family-of-models-with-gpt-5-6/)被Microsoft指定为Copilot首选模型，[缓解了双方关系破裂的猜测](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/openai-says-gpt-5-6-is-the-preferred-model-for-microsoft-copilot-amid-breakup-chatter/)。
- [Anthropic则迎来前美联储主席伯南克加入监督信托](https://www.anthropic.com/news/ben-bernanke)，并公开了[Claude内部“雅可比透镜”技术](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/09/1140293/anthropic-found-a-hidden-space-where-claude-puzzles-over-concepts/)，揭示模型推理过程，提升可解释性。
- [Google再失两名AI专家](https://news.google.)，人才流向Anthropic。
- [AI agent创业公司Lyzr用自家agent完成1亿美元融资](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/an-ai-agent-startup-just-let-its-agent-run-its-100-million-fundraise/)，堪称行为艺术级验证。
收束：OpenAI的人事暗涌与Anthropic的制度化建设形成对比，GPT-5.6的性能提升能否转化为市场份额，要看微软生态的落地速度。
AI.en:
The AI desk is buzzing with OpenAI’s dual news: the launch of GPT-5.6 and the departure of AGI chief Fidji Simo after a prolonged medical leave. The talent war intensifies as Google loses two experts to Anthropic, and a new report reveals 22 professors were poached by top labs in 2026. Anthropic also unveiled a technique to peer inside LLMs, while an AI agent startup raised $100 million by having its own agent run the fundraise.

- [Fidji Simo steps down from OpenAI’s no. 2 role](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/fidji-simo-steps-down-from-openais-no-2-role/) — transitions to part-time advisor; leadership vacuum amid IPO planning.
- [OpenAI launches GPT-5.6](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/openai-launches-its-new-family-of-models-with-gpt-5-6/) — new family of models with improved cybersecurity capabilities; will power Microsoft Copilot 365.
- [Google loses more AI talent to Anthropic](https://news.google.) — two experts reportedly move, continuing a pattern.
- [Anthropic finds hidden space where Claude puzzles](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/07/09/1140293/anthropic-found-a-hidden-space-where-claude-puzzles-over-concepts/) — Jacobian lens reveals internal reasoning structures.
- [AI agent startup Lyzr raises $100M via its own agent](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/an-ai-agent-startup-just-let-its-agent-run-its-100-million-fundraise/) — proof of concept turns into a real fundraise.

**Signal:** OpenAI’s leadership transition during a product launch creates risk; the talent migration to Anthropic suggests the competitive landscape is shifting, and the AI interpretability breakthrough could change how models are audited.

科技产品.zh:
今日科技产品新闻中，微软成为焦点：其[2026年可持续发展报告显示碳排放增长25%](https://www.theverge.com/tech/963728/microsoft-sustainability-report-2026)，达到3400万吨，主要源于数据中心扩张——这与AI算力需求激增直接挂钩。而Xbox CEO Asha Sharma在[宣布裁减3200人后数日](https://www.engadget.com/2211983/days-after-laying-off-3-200-xbox-ceo-asha-sharma-tapped-to-advise-the-federal-reserve-on-jobs/)，被任命为美联储就业顾问，讽刺意味十足。
- [马斯克与SEC达成150万美元和解](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/judge-doesnt-like-elon-musk-settlement-with-sec-but-says-court-cant-block-it/)，法官虽不认同但无法阻止，该案源于其2022年推迟披露Twitter持股。
- [印度智能手机制造进入新阶段](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/after-apple-indias-smartphone-manufacturing-boom-enters-new-phase-with-vivo-jv/)，Vivo与当地企业成立合资公司，可能成为其他中国厂商的模板。
- [Netflix考虑增加常驻频道](https://www.theverge.com/streaming/963733/netflix-always-on-channels-bundles)，类似Pluto TV的线性流媒体模式，以应对用户增长放缓。
收束：科技巨头在扩展业务的同时面临碳排放、就业争议及监管博弈，可持续发展承诺与现实扩张的矛盾日益凸显。
科技产品.en:
Tech product news today is sparse but noteworthy: Microsoft’s carbon footprint jumped 25% due to AI infrastructure, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma was tapped for a Federal Reserve job days after layoffs, and Netflix is considering always-on channels. India’s smartphone manufacturing gets a boost via Vivo’s joint venture, and a federal judge reluctantly approved Elon Musk’s SEC settlement.

- [Microsoft’s carbon emissions rose 25%](https://www.theverge.com/tech/963728/microsoft-sustainability-report-2026) to 34M metric tons in 2025 — AI expansion is the primary driver, raising questions about net-zero pledges.
- [Xbox CEO Asha Sharma to advise Fed on jobs](https://www.engadget.com/2211983/days-after-laying-off-3-200-xbox-ceo-asha-sharma-tapped-to-advise-the-federal-reserve-on-jobs/) — irony noted after Microsoft laid off 3,200.
- [Netflix considers always-on channels](https://www.theverge.com/streaming/963733/netflix-always-on-channels-bundles) — a shift toward linear-style streaming, competing with Pluto TV and Tubi.
- [Vivo joint venture in India](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/after-apple-indias-smartphone-manufacturing-boom-enters-new-phase-with-vivo-jv/) — could become a template for Chinese smartphone makers navigating local manufacturing.
- [Judge reluctantly approves Musk’s $1.5M SEC settlement](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/judge-doesnt-like-elon-musk-settlement-with-sec-but-says-court-cant-block-it/) — over Twitter stock violation, but judge expressed disapproval.

**Signal:** Microsoft’s climate transparency will be tested as AI growth collides with sustainability goals; Netflix’s move to channels signals a consolidation of streaming models.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
Hacker News今日热门话题涵盖技术深度与社会反思。Mitchell Hashimoto（Vagrant、Terraform创始人）[接受访谈](https://alexalejandre.com/programming/interview-with-mitchell-hashimoto/)，详谈其新终端模拟器Ghostty和Zig语言，获173分，开发者对其工程哲学兴趣浓厚。Cloudflare工程师撰文[教大家构建漏洞利用框架](https://blog.cloudflare.com/build-your-own-vulnerability-harness/)，强调白盒测试方法。
- 腾讯公开其[混合3D渲染引擎Hy3](https://hy.tencent.com/research/hy3)，获417分，社区对国产开源图形技术热烈讨论。
- 一篇反思文章[《Focus》](https://boz.com/articles/focus)探讨极简主义与工作效率，得84分。
- 心理学研究[“妈妈，你爱手机胜过爱我吗？”](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychology/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2026.1766665/full)引发40分讨论，触及数字时代亲子关系。
- 长文[《为什么美国救护车那么贵》](https://davidoks.blog/p/why-american-ambulance-rides-are)获140分及181条评论，揭露医疗系统定价黑箱。
收束：社区既有硬核技术分享，也持续关注社会问题与个人成长，构成HackNews独特的知识生态。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community engaged with a diverse set of deep dives: a technical post on building vulnerability harnesses from Cloudflare, a philosophical piece on focus by Boz, a psychology study on parental phone use, and a detailed breakdown of U.S. ambulance costs. Notable launches include Context.dev (YC S26) for web data extraction and Tencent’s Hy3 research. Mitchell Hashimoto discussed Ghostty and Zig.

- [Build your own vulnerability harness](https://blog.cloudflare.com/build-your-own-vulnerability-harness/) — Cloudflare shares practical security engineering techniques.
- [Focus](https://boz.com/articles/focus) — reflections on productivity and attention in a distracted world (84 points, 44 comments).
- [“Mommy, do you love your phone more than me?”](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychology/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2026.1766665/full) — study on children’s perceptions of parental phone use (40 points).
- [Why American ambulance rides are so expensive](https://davidoks.blog/p/why-american-ambulance-rides-are) — viral discussion (140 points, 181 comments).
- [Interview with Mitchell Hashimoto](https://alexalejandre.com/programming/interview-with-mitchell-hashimoto/) — deep insights into Ghostty terminal and Zig language (173 points).

**Signal:** Community interest remains high in practical engineering (vulnerability harness, Ghostty), societal critiques (ambulance costs, phone distraction), and new developer tools (Context.dev, Hy3).

足球.zh:
**⚽ 世界杯进入白热化，四强产生两席——法国完胜摩洛哥，英格兰与挪威针锋相对。场外，克洛普自曝十年前追姆巴佩的疯狂往事，希勒突然看涨英格兰。国内中超申花凭借吴曦点球逼平英博。**

- 🇫🇷[法国2-0摩洛哥](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gy74978myo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，姆巴佩失点后仍斩获第8球，BBC称其为“可能是史上最强法国队”。
- 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧[英格兰面临防线危机](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3eyqdwq392o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：格伊腿筋伤可能缺阵挪威战，赖斯生病；哈兰德则[甩锅给英格兰](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cj3gd8rg628o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)——“压力都在他们那边”。
- 🗣️[克洛普透露十年未竟的姆巴佩转会](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cpd3052gjvxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，当时利物浦已安排私人飞机接姆巴佩家庭谈判。
- 📊[西甲官方评选1/8决赛最佳阵容](https://news.google.)姆巴佩、贝林厄姆领衔，但巴西无人入选。
- 🇨🇳[申花1-1英博](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBwR1JhcXFIWkxvazluS1dhSGJYc1E0VUVrVDNUQlp5TVhfT1EtZjNRZGljZ1dScEpuVWpzV2Z6V2ZOZlRfa2RMY3RPdm1HMEZsd1Y2dC1JVFhuRGRXLVBob19uc2laV25NZV9IV3pWLTNOdw)，吴曦点球救主。

🤔 英格兰伤病与心理战交织，挪威绝非弱旅；法国半决赛对手尚未确定，但姆巴佩状态火热。希勒的“改口”或许反映了外界对英格兰的期待回升，但防线残缺是致命隐患。
足球.en:
The World Cup dominates the football desk: France advanced to the semi-finals with a convincing 2-0 win over Morocco in Boston. Kylian Mbappe redeemed his missed penalty by scoring his eighth goal of the tournament, while Ousmane Dembele added the second. England faces injury concerns ahead of their quarter-final against Norway, with Marc Guehi nursing a hamstring strain and Declan Rice ill. Erling Haaland has added psychological pressure by stating all the pressure is on England. Off-pitch, Jurgen Klopp revealed a fascinating story about how Liverpool tried to sign a teenage Mbappe a decade ago.

- **France 2-0 Morocco (World Cup QF):** Mbappe becomes the star despite a missed penalty. France are now outright favourites to lift the trophy. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/crm0ry2nemmo), [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/france-vs-morocco/report/549862))
- **England injury update:** Guehi (hamstring) and Rice (illness) are doubts for Saturday’s match against Norway. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3eyqdwq392o))
- **Haaland’s mind games:** The Norway striker claims England will face more pressure, setting up a high-stakes clash. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cj3gd8rg628o))
- **Klopp’s Mbappe revelation:** The former Liverpool manager described the failed recruitment effort in detail. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cpd3052gjvxo))
- **Alan Shearer’s change of heart:** He now believes England can win the World Cup. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cz6vz34yv82o))

This desk signals that World Cup knockout drama, injury-related lineup shifts, and psychological warfare will continue to define the narrative as the semi-finals approach.

羽毛球.zh:
**🏸 今日羽毛球圈无赛事焦点，但三位中国名宿的场外故事刷屏——陈宏移居台湾执教、李永波马来西亚种榴莲、高崚再谈家庭生活。这些八卦折射出羽毛球退役运动员多元的人生选择。**

- [陈宏与高崚分手后娶甜妹，现任福建女队教练并移居台湾](https://news.google.)，昔日的“中国男单二单”如今在基层耕耘。
- [李永波淡出公众视野后，被曝在马来西亚经营榴莲园](https://news.google.)，伦敦奥运“让球罗生门”仍被提起。
- [奥运冠军高崚回应情变与现状](https://news.google.)：嫁富豪、儿女双全，45岁状态依然迷人。

📌 当国羽现役选手征战积分赛时，这些退役故事提醒我们，运动员的转型期既是个人选择，也受制于体制与市场。李永波“种榴莲”的传闻真假难辨，但已引发公众对退役安置的关注。
羽毛球.en:
The badminton desk features a series of feature stories from Chinese media focusing on retired and former stars, alongside a brief note on the BWF World Tour Finals. Chen Hong, a former world champion who split with Gao Ling, is now coaching the Fujian women's team and has moved to Taiwan. Li Yongbo, the legendary former head coach of China’s national team, is reportedly farming durian in Malaysia after the controversial London 2012 ‘match-fixing’ incident. Gao Ling herself, an Olympic gold medalist, married a wealthy businessman and has two children. Meanwhile, the BWF World Tour Finals are scheduled, with no specific results reported.

- **Chen Hong’s new chapter:** From a high-profile split with Gao Ling to coaching in Fujian and relocating to Taiwan. ([Sina](https://news.google.))
- **Li Yongbo’s post-China life:** The “godfather” of Chinese badminton now lives in Malaysia growing durian, far from his controversial legacy. ([Sina](https://news.google.))
- **Gao Ling’s post-retirement life:** Olympic champion married a wealthy man, has a son and a daughter, remains glamorous at 45. ([Sina](https://news.google.))
- **BWF World Tour Finals upcoming:** The annual season-ending tournament promises high-level competition. ([BWF](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxQRkhsTlRTeVNxbnk5dVhLZmJDZWRkQ1d5Q2RaS3NCNFluUnBiWmxBVnhRd0dEQXBBSzdueXdpc3ZoOUxncHpoT29yQ2F0dkFLOWFtRDRVTXUtSXB2TkxWdWZKWjNpWHB4dXR1LVhmZ0pkM0VnQ25mNFlHNzUyNS1XTzlRdmN4enVHNEVXWEFMY3ktdw))

These off-court narratives remind us that the badminton world remains deeply connected to its stars’ personal journeys, even as the competitive calendar continues.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
**💬 虎扑今日流量担当：巴西世界杯出局引爆“天亮了”狂欢；马刺25战23胜被赞“GDP传承”；“娶张雨霏要多少彩礼”帖因涉及奥运冠军走入现实；还有C罗“保5争3”历史地位辩论。**

- 🇧🇷[巴西不敌挪威止步16强](https://news.google.)，虎扑JR高呼“太解气了”，桑巴足球的衰落成为热议焦点。
- 🏀[马刺豪取七连胜，近25战23胜](https://news.google.)，球迷感叹“波波维奇还在秀”。
- 💍[“娶张雨霏要多少彩礼？”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE94VnkwSjdBTk5MNmdycWZMdzJwenhfb29wZjNxNlBPUEYxX2FCX1RiS1h5eDlYNFcta1hSZUFfeGNGUHdWOEN6ZFVjekJfUmtRWjNrcUY2MzFsWlpmU0tlOUtXSi1aeDY3NzNjV2NzWG9LQQ) 帖登上步行街首页，奥运冠军的商业价值与个人选择被放到天平上。
- 🐐[C罗2018年原地退役历史地位保5争3？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQS0NiWF8zWm83UVcxOTdOZW02X05mSmJCZ2dNR3FETFBqTW5uQTlJWVFwb0xobkpkdTVWZzNuRE11WEV6YkJMOUkyRjJEV3ROdlEwdWtzNEpPaTVQM3JmblhIZ1FyX1lzUko3Ylh3MFFHdjhBY1haOExmYkJZNFQ5WTBITmxqREtqQjNaWjl3Tk43ZE1QRTJ4WXd1V2pFYTlaTE4yT2t1Znk5UHN1NV9qQ2xUZw) 帖下500+回复，皇马专区与梅罗粉丝激战。

📌 虎扑今日关键词：世界杯冷门、NBA黑马、跨界彩礼——社区生态依然以“引战+玩梗”为核心动力。巴西出局可能长期影响南美足球讨论基调。
虎扑社区动态.en:
The Hupu community is alive with heated discussions spanning basketball, football, and esports. A major shock: Brazil’s elimination by Norway in the World Cup round of 16 sparked passionate reactions, while the San Antonio Spurs’ seven-game winning streak (23 wins in last 25 games) drew praise. NBA-related chatter includes Rui Hachimura’s impressive 44.3% three-point shooting last season and Patrick Beverley clarifying a misunderstanding between Giannis Antetokounmpo and Myles Turner. A legacy debate about Cristiano Ronaldo’s hypothetical retirement in 2018 and an esports update (G2 defeating T1 in MSI) round out the feed.

- **Brazil’s shock World Cup exit:** Norway beat Brazil in the round of 16, causing major discussions in the community. ([MSN](https://news.google.))
- **Spurs red-hot:** San Antonio’s dominant run (7 straight wins, 23-2 in last 25) continues. ([MSN](https://news.google.))
- **Beverley clarifies Giannis-Turner incident:** The veteran guard says he helped smooth over a misunderstanding about lateness. ([MSN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_))
- **Rui Hachimura’s elite shooting:** The Japanese forward posted a 44.3% three-point percentage last season, ranking 5th in the NBA. ([MSN](https://news.google.))
- **C罗 legacy debate:** The community weighs in on what would happen if Ronaldo had retired in 2018. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQS0NiWF8zWm83UVcxOTdOZW02X05mSmJCZ2dNR3FETFBqTW5uQTlJWVFwb0xobkpkdTVWZzNuRE11WEV6YkJMOUkyRjJEV3ROdlEwdWtzNEpPaTVQM3JmblhIZ1FyX1lzUko3Ylh3MFFHdjhBY1haOExmYkJZNFQ5WTBITmxqREtqQjNaWjl3Tk43ZE1QRTJ4WXd1V2pFYTlaTE4yT2t1Znk5UHN1NV9qQ2xUZw))

Hupu remains the pulse of Chinese sports fandom, blending basketball analytics, World Cup shock, and hypotheticals into a single feed.

篮球.zh:
**🏀 今日NBA处于休赛期，最大新闻来自欧洲：一位曾隔扣勒布朗·詹姆斯的球员（疑似法国前锋）与欧洲俱乐部签下3年1200万欧元合同，基本宣告不回NBA。**

- [3年1200万欧元！曾隔扣詹姆斯，如今基本不回NBA](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxPLXNRNFJoYm1aZUluUjI3aHpZcTZfYU42Z2QycXo3TmtTNmhkUFdudmJPcHd5a1B4YlhDYm9ZcDB4bVFZbmk4RHZvanJMbzZWSVNTQ0NiZzR1TjdGTXVFeDRSSFNhTGtfZHVtMVl0cVhrNlFlOWZDRUdQV09iX0RNaktwempVdWxEdC1CTUN3) —— 这桩签约在自由市场相对平静的夏天显得格外刺眼，也反映出欧洲篮球联赛对“失意NBA球员”的吸引力。

📌 详情有限，但“隔扣詹姆斯”这个标签已足够在虎扑引爆回忆。欧洲联赛的高薪与稳定上场时间，正在改变边缘NBA球员的选择逻辑。

（注：若需更具体姓名，原文未明确，推测为法国前锋Mickaël Pietrus或类似球员，但此信息待验证。）
篮球.en:
The basketball desk carries only one item: a report that a player who once dunked on LeBron James has signed a three-year, €12 million contract in Europe, effectively ending any immediate hopes of returning to the NBA. The article, sourced from Sina in Chinese, does not name the player explicitly but references a notable dunker. The deal suggests that European leagues continue to offer competitive salaries that can lure former NBA talents away permanently.

- **Former LeBron-dunker signs €12M deal in Europe:** A three-year contract worth €12 million is reportedly finalized, with the player now unlikely to come back to the NBA. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxPLXNRNFJoYm1aZUluUjI3aHpZcTZfYU42Z2QycXo3TmtTNmhkUFdudmJPcHd5a1B4YlhDYm9ZcDB4bVFZbmk4RHZvanJMbzZWSVNTQ0NiZzR1TjdGTXVFeDRSSFNhTGtfZHVtMVl0cVhrNlFlOWZDRUdQV09iX0RNaktwempVdWxEdC1CTUN3))

This single piece signals an ongoing trend of NBA players moving to European clubs for financial security and playing time, a development that could reshape roster strategies for both sides of the Atlantic.

欧美.zh: 今日欧美娱乐圈三线并进：明星与 AI 的肖像权战争正式打响，经典再创作与票房冷思考形成对冲。最值得关注的是 [SAG-AFTRA 建议会员退出 Meta 的 Muse AI 图像工具](https://deadline.com/2026/07/sag-aftra-recommends-members-opt-out-meta-ai-feature-1236979025/)，这是好莱坞工会首次就生成式 AI 发布具体操作指引，料将引发大规模 opt-out 潮。音乐界方面，[安东尼·霍普金斯签约 Decca Classics 并将于八月发行首张原创古典专辑](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/anthony-hopkins-decca-classics-life-is-a-dream-album-1236806236/)，88 岁奥斯卡影帝再拓艺术边界。电影市场层面，[迪士尼真人版《海洋奇缘》面临票房考验](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/moana-box-office-test-disney-live-action-dwayne-johnson-1236643385/)，距前作动画续集《海洋奇缘2》大热仅一年半，观众是否审美疲劳待验证。此外，[Dan Trachtenberg 执导的动画恐怖喜剧《Freddy the 13th》定档 2028 年 10 月 13 日](https://deadline.com/2026/07/dan-trachtenberg-freddy-the-13th-release-date-1236979006/)，派拉蒙在邪典 IP 上押注创新。判断：AI 焦虑正从内部瓦解平台信任，工会的“保护肖像”行动将成行业新基准。
欧美.en:
Hollywood is navigating AI privacy disputes, scheduling conflicts, and cross-genre music experiments. SAG-AFTRA's Meta opt-out recommendation underscores growing tension over digital likeness rights, while Anthony Hopkins' classical pivot shows actors expanding creative boundaries. The USMNT World Cup exit scored historic ratings, proving sports-entertainment crossover power.
- **SAG-AFTRA vs Meta AI** – Union instructs members on opting out of Meta's Muse Image tool to 'protect your likeness'. [Read](https://deadline.com/2026/07/sag-aftra-recommends-members-opt-out-meta-ai-feature-1236979025/)
- **Anthony Hopkins Debuts as Composer** – Decca Classics signs the actor for an album of his six-decade compositions, performed by Philharmonia Orchestra. [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/anthony-hopkins-decca-classics-life-is-a-dream-album-1236806236/)
- **USMNT World Cup Sets Ratings Record** – 33.086 million viewers for the Round of 16 match, highest ever for a soccer telecast in the U.S. [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/world-cup-ratings-record-usmnt-belgium-fox-1236975996/)
- **Jennifer Garner Champions LA Filming** – Emphasizes importance of working in Hollywood amid tax incentive debates. [Quote](https://deadline.com/2026/07/jennifer-garner-so-important-film-la-1236978982/)
- **Moana Live-Action Faces Box Office Test** – Opening less than two years after Moana 2, the Dwayne Johnson starrer must prove franchise staying power. [THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/moana-box-office-test-disney-live-action-dwayne-johnson-1236643385/)

**Signal:** The AI-actor rights clash will likely influence upcoming union negotiations and state-level digital likeness legislation.

日韩.zh: 韩娱今日以“离别”为主调。顶流情侣[IU 与李钟硕正式宣布分手](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853684wpp/breaking-iu-and-lee-jong-suk-confirm-breakup)，四年恋情结束，双方均表示“保留好同事关系”，不排除后续有合作可能。与此同时，[前本月少女成员 Chuu 与 ATRP 合约到期未续](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853648wpp/chuu-parts-ways-with-agent-after-3-years)，独立音乐人身份再出发。舞台方面，[IVE 成员 Gaeul 因行程冲突缺席 8 月香港 TIMA 颁奖礼](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853683wpp/ives-gaeul-to-be-absent-from-2026-tmelive-international-music-awards-tima-due-to-scheduling-conflict)，STARSHIP 未说明具体冲突原因，粉丝猜测与个资调整有关。新团动态上，[ARTMS 公布世界巡演“Art of BLUE BLOOD”首轮城市](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853699wpp/artms-announces-dates-and-cities-for-2026-world-tour-art-of-blue-blood)，9 月首尔起跑；[izna 也宣布首次巡回“WHO DAT GIRL?”](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853677wpp/izna-announces-first-stops-for-2026-tour-who-dat-girl)，新生代女团加速海外扩张。剧集方面，[Netflix《东宫》公开 Nam Joo Hyuk 与 Roh Yoon Seo 的幽灵题材剧照](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853656wpp/nam-joo-hyuk-and-roh-yoon-seo-fall-into-chaos-after-encountering-ghosts-in-new-drama-the-east-palace)，视觉风格暗黑。判断：韩娱偶像产业正经历“合约冷静期”与“国际曝光期”的双重节奏，分合皆常态。
日韩.en:
K-pop and K-drama dominated the 日韩 desk with a high-profile breakup, world tour announcements, and agency changes. IU and Lee Jong Suk's split after four years was the biggest shock, while groups like ARTMS and izna revealed tour stops. Chuu's departure from ATRP adds to ongoing agency shifts.
- **IU and Lee Jong Suk Confirm Breakup** – Both agencies confirm amicable split; will remain colleagues. [Read](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853684wpp/breaking-iu-and-lee-jong-suk-confirm-breakup)
- **ARTMS and izna Announce World Tours** – ARTMS kicks off 'Art of BLUE BLOOD' in Seoul Sept 5-6, then North America; izna starts 'WHO DAT GIRL?' Sept 19-20. [ARTMS](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853699wpp/artms-announces-dates-and-cities-for-2026-world-tour-art-of-blue-blood) | [izna](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853677wpp/izna-announces-first-stops-for-2026-tour-who-dat-girl)
- **Chuu Parts Ways with ATRP** – Exclusive contract expires; fans speculate on next steps for the soloist. [Statement](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853648wpp/chuu-parts-ways-with-agency-after-3-years)
- **Teasers for 'Flex X Cop 2' and 'The East Palace'** – Star-studded cameos and ghostly premises generate buzz. [Flex X Cop 2](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853685wpp/watch-flex-x-cop-2-reveals-star-studded-special-appearance-lineup-in-new-teaser) | [The East Palace](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853656wpp/nam-joo-hyuk-and-roh-yoon-seo-fall-into-chaos-after-encountering-ghosts-in-new-drama-the-east-palace)

**Signal:** The IU–Lee Jong Suk breakup will likely dominate celebrity news cycles and could affect their upcoming projects and endorsements.

中国.zh: 国内娱乐今日焦点集中在 AI 伦理、市场冷热不均与社会议题对冲。科技层面，[AI“偷声”带货引发警惕——明星未开口却被伪造声音推销](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTFByNDFJblFrcTQ3SzlRTEZLTGF6YWZvMGV2aDRCLThkZ0h6b2daRWlHMzhYY1dmQndPaHZKczgzMzVrQlBwV1RpRnZQUkFUaTdpZTJKYVI2VW03clRLeG1xcHktclo0YXc)，与 SAG-AFTRA 行动形成全球呼应。产业方面，[周星驰《功夫女足》在超百部影片中热度领跑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE5YMWxydjBzeGdpRlJkaFp6QmxvNmZpOVdVd1I5cUVoUjBPNlR5dlNobnlsU2tWVDhLMG1JUWEwZkNUUGpYbW5ZdQ)，但暑期档尚缺现象级大片压阵；同时，[国产真人互动影游在海外刷屏](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOdHRxR3ZMRTlFbUs3OGJmTlhZRXR1ZzhPS2djeWZvYzNSajJxMFFRMmlreERzWjNxV00wTHVYdHgtMHQyaTVRNm53Z1ZBdUFPMFZwTWVER2l3R0JsNmtqUXJIVnc1MTZqMUV2UmpWV1NZOUd1Z3Z1dVQ0WTg0YjdMVVpkZTk4M3BxZGRXcQ)，可能开辟新赛道。社交舆论场出现撕裂：[广西洪灾难上热搜，明星私事却霸屏](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFBTeGJvWkQ3Uk1ITERtWkhWOVg5bWZLMWhwLVIzeEdEN3B4YzV4ZXRxS0RWbzlSSndxb1BkTVduN3JxTXZLbEQzMjdLcURqM052OE9mbW1YeU5IMV81QnVmX0J6SFg3X2g1TUcwYw)，媒体伦理讨论再起。此外，[黄晓明等 12 位明星亮相时尚中国之夜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPcU8xdlNfdkFvMC1MOHVDYUZ4SEh5ZjdrY2haSFNaVFdsSnJ6bnQtdTVVeVdIVXNKNVhaMU5ZWUVUeEg2MGtCVUFLVTkwQUlRNEU5Vk1xdE9pYU1lTzAyMHJiNGFubDZzOEdOdzdfSG1TSWhwZ21GdzlHcTZYVEJubmUtWjVpeWhXY2lGdldJa1BPQ1B2Y3F3M3dLVlR2T29WVnJhSXJSMExNVVE) ，虞书欣接受央视国际频道采访。判断：中国娱乐业正面临“技术伦理、内容创新、社会价值”三维重塑，公众对明星的审视标准日益严苛。
中国.en:
Chinese entertainment saw a mix of glamorous red carpets, AI controversies, and a blockbuster summer film race. Stephen Chow's 'Kung Fu Women's Football' leads buzz amid a crowded but underwhelming lineup. AI voice theft and interactive gaming went viral, while a social media storm contrasted celebrity gossip with real-world tragedy in Guangxi.
- **Stephen Chow's 'Kung Fu Women's Football' Tops Heat** – 100+ films hit summer season but few major blockbusters; Chow's film stands out. [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE5YMWxydjBzeGdpRlJkaFp6QmxvNmZpOVdVd1I5cUVoUjBPNlR5dlNobnlsU2tWVDhLMG1JUWEwZkNUUGpYbW5ZdQ)
- **AI 'Voice Theft' Controversy** – Stars' voices used without consent for AI sales; warning from state media. [中国青年网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTFByNDFJblFrcTQ3SzlRTEZLTGF6YWZvMGV2aDRCLThkZ0h6b2daRWlHMzhYY1dmQndPaHZKczgzMzVrQlBwV1RpRnZQUkFUaTdpZTJKYVI2VW03clRLeG1xcHktclo0YXc)
- **Interactive Film Games Global Breakout** – Chinese interactive dramas (真人互动影游) see overseas success; industry observers call it a new trend. [搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOdHRxR3ZMRTlFbUs3OGJmTlhZRXR1ZzhPS2djeWZvYzNSajJxMFFRMmlreERzWjNxV00wTHVYdHgtMHQyaTVRNm53Z1ZBdUFPMFZwTWVER2l3R0JsNmtqUXJIVnc1MTZqMUV2UmpWV1NZOUd1Z3Z1dVQ0WTg0YjdMVVpkZTk4M3BxZGRXcQ)
- **Huang Xiaoming Leads Fashion China Night** – 12 stars grace red carpet; industry networking highlight. [新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPcU8xdlNfdkFvMC1MOHVDYUZ4SEh5ZjdrY2haSFNaVFdsSnJ6bnQtdTVVeVdIVXNKNVhaMU5ZWUVUeEg2MGtCVUFLVTkwQUlRNEU5Vk1xdE9pYU1lTzAyMHJiNGFubDZzOEdOdzdfSG1TSWhwZ21GdzlHcTZYVEJubmUtWjVpeWhXY2lGdldJa1BPQ1B2Y3F3M3dLVlR2T29WVnJhSXJSMExNVVE)
- **Guangxi Flood vs. Celebrity Gossip** – Outrage as disaster news fails to trend while celebrity trivia dominates, sparking debate on platform priorities. [人民报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFBTeGJvWkQ3Uk1ITERtWkhWOVg5bWZLMWhwLVIzeEdEN3B4YzV4ZXRxS0RWbzlSSndxb1BkTVduN3JxTXZLbEQzMjdLcURqM052OE9mbW1YeU5IMV81QnVmX0J6SFg3X2g1TUcwYw)

**Signal:** The tension between AI ethics and celebrity culture will intensify as the summer box office and online discourse converge.

微博社区动态.zh: 微博今日热榜呈现“去清纯化”与“剧集话题内卷”两大特征。最爆点是[王源胸肌热搜登顶，粉丝集体改口叫“王总”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE11cEtYV1A5NEZ0RGwycHlzQUh6SkNlODRTZnlIV1AwN0U0dTlXU1F6dlpBak5abWRrb1M3N01Nc0JVRGs4S3BEVzVpcHRYZ2FFWkI1ckpoWWRmYkVXbldLanlEc3RVWWlmcTQxV3hmRWs)，偶像“性张力”营销成功破圈。剧集衍生话题密集：孟子义新剧《百花杀》被问“李昀锐为何不包场”，随即又有[杨紫与孟子义的友谊起源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9TOXo5Zzhod1NvSHBNQkdxRHVZblZMMG1NTE9Rbk5aZmpkTnBPd0xUMTcyTGM3amo1YWVWMXdJRWxCS3FseDR6NF9GbHhpVlQzWWkzUHlQdFhNdDZhcjNod1o0R0h4Wkw0WVZlRUNKUQ)登上讨论区，显示粉丝高度关注演员私下关系。在播剧数据对比盘点了[张婧仪、虞书欣、鞠婧祎等主演作品的热搜表现](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5nc2FUWXZxTkF4djExTHhFbjh3RnEyc2FRQVZlODZTR2lLM0RUVmN3R3pLdjdYZEFob1Jzaml3dFlOeDE3SEZQNEtnZWVMVk81cFNsSDV0eU1ZSGYxMVFXS21GMA)，数据之战愈发激烈。另外，[张真源密室抱人登上热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxOUGZCYjRUU2JFVVVQMDR6QVV1T1JGZklJc0h6dUIyVWZBRHFMN0FGUVYtUFVIWU13MHZ6cVAtenJWOUtLTnR3MmlWeXhVaFM2TndKWk5ZaVdlUmVhMUd2TEJpMDRTcFZVOXRMdDlqMk9wMEx6UXJJaVd1X2FsY1RZUGkyck9nWTIwYWNXYXBtZEJfT1FNZTNxeVM5VkpFMTRSdHBvRUdkNFpvU1NwblBpdQ)，因“先问性别再锁死”的举动获得好评。判断：微博娱乐生态正从“作品安利”转向“人设切片与关系网挖掘”，偶像的每一个细节都在被放大解读。
微博社区动态.en:
Weibo trends were driven by physical appearances, fan loyalty, and drama-related queries. Wang Yuan's chest shot topped charts, while Zhang Zhenyuan's careful 'ask gender before hug' moment went viral. Fans also debated support for Meng Ziyi's new drama and compared hot search data across multiple shows.
- **Wang Yuan Chest Muscles Top Weibo** – Fans humorously rename him 'Wang Zong' (boss) after revealing physique. [Page](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE11cEtYV1A5NEZ0RGwycHlzQUh6SkNlODRTZnlIV1AwN0U0dTlXU1F6dlpBak5abWRrb1M3N01Nc0JVRGs4S3BEVzVpcHRYZ2FFWkI1ckpoWWRmYkVXbldLanlEc3RVWWlmcTQxV3hmRWs)
- **Zhang Zhenyuan Hug in Escape Room** – The star asked 'male or female' before hugging, earning praise for manners; trended heavily. [Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxOUGZCYjRUU2JFVVVQMDR6QVV1T1JGZklJc0h6dUIyVWZBRHFMN0FGUVYtUFVIWU13MHZ6cVAtenJWOUtLTnR3MmlWeXhVaFM2TndKWk5ZaVdlUmVhMUd2TEJpMDRTcFZVOXRMdDlqMk9wMEx6UXJJaVd1X2FsY1RZUGkyck9nWTIwYWNXYXBtZEJfT1FNZTNxeVM5VkpFMTRSdHBvRUdkNFpvU1NwblBpdQ)
- **Meng Ziyi's 'Baihua Sha' – Why No Support from Li Yunrui?** – Fans question costar's lack of promotion, sparking speculation about off-screen dynamics. [Question](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE51c20xTG05QkVYNHh3U3hnT3RRdnhHclFJazFtamZMeGxEaTZWTmd2c1RCYXY2OFAyQnpwemp6ckJhTnFkak5QVnI0S282V3lfREFDcDJLcnZ3a2F0TERlRXdtZ1VZVm92LUpfeVg3Y0U)
- **In-Show Hot Search Data Comparison** – Fans compare trending stats for Zhang Jingyi, Yu Shuxin, Ju Jingyi dramas. [Data](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5nc2FUWXZxTkF4djExTHhFbjh3RnEyc2FRQVZlODZTR2lLM0RUVmN3R3pLdjdYZEFob1Jzaml3dFlOeDE3SEZQNEtnZWVMVk81cFNsSDV0eU1ZSGYxMVFXS21GMA)

**Signal:** Weibo remains a barometer for fan-centric celebrity moments, often eclipsing substantive entertainment news.
